title: Analyst, Bordereaux Management - UW Services Ops
description:
Gurgaon, India
   

  

 As a fast growing Bordereaux Management deparment, we are looking for an Analyst to support our Bordereaux Management Insurance Platform. The successful applicant will join a collaborative team responsible for monitoring, cleansing, and mapping third party data to internal systems, while simultaneously driving continuous improvement initiatives to better meet business requirements
   

  

 You will be a member a of team responsible for analysing, cleansing and processing data as well as contacting clients in order to improve data quality and maintain good relationships with our stakeholders.
   

  

**What You’ll Be DOING**
 What will your essential responsibilities include?
   

  

* Performing accurate and timely analysis and reconciliation of financial statements received from third parties containing risk, premium and claims information
* Processing third party data into internal systems.
* Liaising with internal and external parties in a composed, timely and accurate manner.
* Producing documentation in relation to third party payments (such as claims, commission, fees and return premiums).
* Maintaining good technical knowledge in respect of all Bordereaux Management duties.
* Maintaining a good awareness of relevant regulatory requirements.
* Analyzing Gaps in received bordereaux against Lloyds, AXA XL and other required standards.
* Mapping bordereau and uploading to bordereau systems.
* Automating, enhancing and improving existing processes/tools.
* Adapting and working under pressure in order to successfully meet deadlines.
* Maintaining good relationship with our clients and stakeholders
* Prioritising your workload effectively.
* Providing regular status updates to management.
* Perform other ad hoc duties as required by management.


 You will report to local Assistant Manager..
   

  

**What You Will BRING**
 We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
   

  

**Required Skills And Abilities**
* Education: educated to degree level, active students with full time availability or equivalent through relevant work experience
* Insurance market experience: ideally prior experience in a commercial insurance or financial services environment
* Excellent data processing skills
* Microsoft Excel advanced proficiency
* Computer literate including Microsoft Outlook, Word, PowerPoint and other commonly used software.
* Excellent knowledge of excel (especially different formulas)
* Language proficiency: must have the ability to communicate (verbal \& written) proficiently in English
* Inquisitive mind with compelling analytical thinking skills
* Solid organizational skills including attention to detail and multitasking skills
* Communications: must have compelling communication skills, being able to communicate effectively both internally and externally at all levels
* Quality: has a concern for ensuring work is completed to a consistently high standard
* Process driven: seeks options for streamlining and consistency
* Continuous self\-improvement: keeps knowledge current in all relevant areas


**Who WE are**
 AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
   

  

 How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data\-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
   

  

 With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
   

  

 Learn more at axaxl.com
   

  

**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
 AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
 *It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*
* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ\+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family\-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter


 Learn more at axaxl.com/about\-us/inclusion\-and\-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

**Total Rewards**
 AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
   

  

 We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
   

  

**Sustainability**
 At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever\-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023\-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
   

  

**Our Pillars**
* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems \- the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far\-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal\-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.


 For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Senior RPA Developer \- Core
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


**About the Role**

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.


This role is suitable for candidates with **1 to 4 years of relevant experience** . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
* Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
* Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
* Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
* Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
* Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
* Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
* Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
* Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
* Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
* Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
* Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
* Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
* Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
* Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
* Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Strong programming capability in **Python** , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
* Hands\-on exposure to **Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development** .
* Working knowledge of **RAG architecture** , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
* Experience or strong project exposure in **agentic AI concepts** such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
* Exposure to frameworks such as **LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI** , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
* Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
* Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
* Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
* Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.

**Preferred / Additional Skills**

* Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
* Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
* Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
* Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
* Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
* Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
**Other Requirements**
----------------------


**Experience Criteria**

* **1 to 4 years** of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.

**Educational Qualifications**

**Mandatory Qualification:**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a **Quality Engineer** with 1–3 years of experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in **sheet metal fabrication, automobile, engineering or precision manufacturing**.

The candidate will be responsible for inspecting sheet\-metal components and assemblies at different stages of production and ensuring that products meet **customer drawings, dimensions, tolerances and quality requirements**.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform **incoming, in\-process and final inspection** of sheet\-metal components.
* Inspect parts as per **customer drawings, specifications and inspection plans**.
* Check **dimensions, tolerances, hole sizes, bending dimensions, flatness and overall part geometry**.
* Inspect components after processes such as **laser cutting, CNC bending, welding and fabrication**.
* Identify defects such as **burrs, scratches, dents, dimensional variation, improper bending, welding defects and surface\-finish issues**.
* Use measuring instruments such as **Vernier Caliper, Micrometer, Height Gauge, measuring gauges, etc.**
* Read and interpret **2D engineering drawings, dimensions, GD\&T and tolerances**.
* Prepare and maintain **inspection reports, check sheets and quality records**.
* Record and communicate quality issues/rejections to the production team.
* Support **root cause analysis, corrective action and preventive action (CAPA)** for quality problems.
* Coordinate with Production and other departments to resolve quality\-related issues.
* Monitor rejection, rework and defect data and support continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with **SOPs, work instructions and quality standards**.
* Support final inspection and ensure products are ready for dispatch as per required quality standards.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of **Sheet Metal Quality / Quality Control**.
* Good understanding of **engineering drawings, dimensions and tolerances**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Vernier, Micrometer and other measuring instruments**.
* Knowledge of **7 QC Tools, 5 Why, Root Cause Analysis and CAPA**.
* Basic knowledge of **GD\&T** will be preferred.
* Basic knowledge of **MS Excel and quality documentation**.
* Good observation, communication and problem\-solving skills.

Educational Qualification

**Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech** in Mechanical, Production, Industrial Engineering or a related field.

Candidate Profile

* **1–3 years of relevant experience** in Quality/Quality Control.
* Candidates with experience in **sheet metal fabrication, automobile, auto components, engineering or manufacturing industries** will be preferred.
* Candidates should be comfortable working in a **shop\-floor/manufacturing environment**.

description:
**Working with Us**
 Challenging. Meaningful. Life\-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high\-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.
   

  

 Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more careers.bms.com/working\-with\-us.
   

  

 The Software Engineer of Analytics Engineering provides hands\-on technical support to help develop and maintain core data models and the core data layer, working closely with and under the guidance of senior team members. This role is ideal for an early\-career engineer who is eager to build foundational skills in developing robust, scalable, and well\-documented data models and pipelines, while supporting self\-service analytics across the organization.
   

  

 We are seeking a motivated Analytical Engineer with 1\-3 years of experience to join our team. This role bridges the gap between data engineering and data analytics, focusing on transforming raw data into structured, business\-ready datasets. The ideal candidate will support the design, development, and implementation of analytical workflows, helping ensure that data is clean, well\-modeled, and optimized for business intelligence and decision\-making. This role requires foundational technical skills in data transformation, modeling, and pipeline optimization (preferably using DBT). Additionally, a successful candidate is an effective communicator who is comfortable learning to explain technical information to a variety of stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Major Duties**
* Collaborate with the business to gather requirements and deliver data\-products to enable data\-informed decision\-making.
* As a member of the team, develop a centralized data\-layer to deliver data\-products at scale to the business.
* Use ELT framework to help transform raw or semi\-structured data into a contextualized data model (preferably using DBT), supporting architectural solutions (preferably AWS) to drive efficiency.
* Partner with AI and ML teams to deliver the data skeleton for AI\-enabled internal tools.
* Work within DBT to deliver documented, tested, and DRY (“don’t\-repeat\-yourself”) code.
* Follow analytical lifecycle process and quality frameworks to deliver accurate data to internal consumers on\-time.
* Focus on innovative solutions to increase speed\-to\-delivery and accelerate business decision\-making.
* Support gathering of business requirements, help track measurable outcomes, and assist in developing analytical product plans, learning to translate complexity for various stakeholders.


**Qualifications/Degree/Certification/Licensure**
* Computer Science, Physics, Math, Data Science, Pharmaceutical Science, or Engineering area of study preferred
* 1\-3 years of experience in analytical engineering, data modeling, or a similar role
* Some hands\-on experience with or exposure to dbt(Not mandatory)
* Proficiency with SQL, SPARK and Python
* Knowledge of data engineering tools (AWS, Airflow) and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
* Experience with version control (e.g. Git, SVN) and Agile development
* Proven analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Developing ability to gather requirements to understand business needs and support technical solutions
* Good communication and presentation skills, with a willingness to develop the ability to explain analyses and outcomes to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Familiarity with AI, ML, predictive modeling a plus
* Familiarity with our toolkit desired work information process tools (JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow, MS suites); data\-related tools (Oracle, Redshift, PostgreSQL, CDP Impala, Athena)
* Eagerness to learn and grow within complex, cross\-functional projects that involve collaborating with team members from various functions.


*If you come across a role that intrigues you but doesn’t perfectly line up with your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. You could be one step away from work that will transform your life and career.*
**Uniquely Interesting Work, Life\-changing Careers**
 With a single vision as inspiring as “Transforming patients’ lives through science™ ”, every BMS employee plays an integral role in work that goes far beyond ordinary. Each of us is empowered to apply our individual talents and unique perspectives in a supportive culture, promoting global participation in clinical trials, while our shared values of passion, innovation, urgency, accountability, inclusion and integrity bring out the highest potential of each of our colleagues.

The occupancy type that you are assigned is determined by the nature and responsibilities of your role

For these roles, onsite presence is considered an essential job function and is critical to collaboration, innovation, productivity, and a positive Company culture. For field\-based and remote\-by\-design roles the ability to physically travel to visit customers, patients or business partners and to attend meetings on behalf of BMS as directed is an essential job function.

title: Quality Assurance Test Engineer
description:
**Typesider \| Noida \| Hybrid \| Full\-time \| 0–3 Years**

Compensation: **₹1–3 LPA**

**About Typesider**

Typesider is a reward based Windows desktop application that turns everyday computer activity into tangible rewards.

Users earn Typoints based on keyboard keystrokes and mouse clicks while using their computers normally. Typoints can be redeemed for coupons, discounts, exclusive brand offers, and soon, cashback.

Typesider is designed to work seamlessly in the background and follows a privacy first approach. It counts activity volume but does not read, record, or store what users type or the content of their computer activity.

We’re building a consumer product where reliability, usability, privacy, and trust are critical.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Quality Assurance Test Engineer to help us test and improve Typesider as we continue developing and releasing the product.

You’ll work closely with the product and development teams to test the Windows application, identify bugs, explore edge cases, and ensure new features work reliably for real users.

This is a hands on role where you’ll have a direct impact on product quality.

**What You’ll Do**

* Test the Typesider Windows desktop application across different user scenarios
* Create, document, and execute manual test cases and test scenarios
* Perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
* Test the complete user journey, including installation, onboarding, streaks, reward days, reward claims, and redemption
* Test new features and product updates before release
* Identify bugs, edge cases, and usability issues
* Document bugs clearly with steps to reproduce, expected behavior, actual behavior, severity, and supporting information
* Verify fixes and perform regression testing
* Test different Windows environments and user scenarios
* Work closely with developers and the product team to understand and resolve issues
* Think like a real user and identify issues that could impact trust, engagement, retention, and overall experience
* Help improve testing processes and documentation as the product grows

**What We’re Looking For**

* 0–3 years of experience in QA, software testing, or a related field
* Freshers and candidates with 1–3 years of experience are welcome to apply
* Good understanding of manual testing and software testing principles
* Ability to create and execute clear test cases and test scenarios
* Understanding of functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify bugs and edge cases
* Ability to write clear and reproducible bug reports
* Good analytical and problem solving skills
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfortable working closely with developers and product teams
* Willingness to explore a product deeply and question how things work

**Good to Have**

* Experience testing Windows desktop applications
* Familiarity with Jira or similar bug tracking tools
* Basic understanding of API testing
* Exposure to automation testing or QA automation tools
* Experience testing consumer software or applications involving rewards, subscriptions, payments, or user accounts

**What We Value**

We’re looking for someone who doesn't just follow a checklist.

A good QA engineer should be able to ask:

What happens if the user does this?

What happens if the system fails here?

Can this feature be misunderstood or misused?

Does this actually work the way a real user would expect?

Your ability to think through these scenarios and uncover problems will be a major part of the role.

**Why Join Typesider**

Typesider is an early stage consumer product, so you’ll have the opportunity to work closely with the team building the product and see your work directly influence releases.

You’ll be testing a product used by real users and helping build the quality standards and QA processes as the product grows.

**Work Details**

Compensation: ₹1–3 LPA

Work Mode: Hybrid

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Working Hours: 10AM \- 5PM

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

 We are seeking a Software Engineer II to join our App Platform and Functions engineering team. App Platform is DigitalOcean’s managed PaaS: customers ship apps from source to production on Kubernetes\-backed infrastructure without managing clusters themselves. Functions is our serverless compute product, running event\-driven workloads on a secure, multi\-tenant runtime. Together these products sit on the critical path for developers deploying and scaling modern applications—and increasingly AI and agent workloads—on DigitalOcean.
   

  

 In this role, you will contribute meaningfully to building and operating the control plane and runtime systems that power App Platform and Functions. You will work within established technical frameworks, implement features against well\-scoped designs, and grow your expertise in distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native platforms. title: PRODOPS (PRODUCTION OPERATIONS)
description:
**About Novatro** 





 We're a growing and focused team that moves fast and builds with intention — passionate about creating a great culture and transforming how industrial operations run. Every person here has real ownership and real impact. Novatro is building an AI\-powered Intelligent Manufacturing Platform that is reshaping how medium\-to\-large manufacturers operate across industries including oil \& gas, aerospace, and defence.
 




  





**The Opportunity** 





 Are you someone who thrives on keeping complex operations running smoothly behind the scenes? We're looking for a ProdOps (Production Operations) specialist to help ensure our platform runs reliably in production and that operational issues are caught and resolved before they impact our customers.
 




  





**Salary and Benefits** 



* We offer a competitive salary, based on skills and experience with lots of opportunities for career growth
* This is a hybrid, permanent full time position based in India



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Monitor platform performance and reliability in production, identifying and escalating issues proactively
* Coordinate with engineering to triage, prioritize, and resolve production incidents
* Build and maintain operational dashboards, alerts, and runbooks
* Support release and deployment processes to minimize disruption to customers
* Work closely with Customer Experience to understand how production issues are impacting real customer workflows
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve operational stability and reduce recurring issues
* Watch production health against our SLOs. The starting target is 99\.9% monthly availability, with alarms on error rate, web latency, Sidekiq queue latency, database pressure, and Redis. Check the web app, background jobs, the load balancer, PostgreSQL, and Redis before a problem spreads.
* Watch production health for the Node.js API, the React application, background workers, the load balancer, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Alarms cover error rate, p95 and p99 latency, default\-queue latency over 60 seconds, heavy\-queue latency over 15 minutes, database connections, and Redis memory or evictions.
* Triage incidents from CloudWatch alarms, synthetic checks, security findings, and user reports. Set severity from SEV1 to SEV4, open the incident channel, and coordinate diagnosis across dashboards, logs, and traces.
* During a material incident, own the customer update with Customer Experience. Confirm the service has recovered against the SLO before the incident is closed, then write the post\-incident review and assign repeat issues to an owner.
* Support the release bake window. Confirm what changed, watch rollback alarms, and roll back the affected release when a deploy alarm or smoke test fails. Freeze deploys during SEV1\.
* Build and keep the dashboards and runbooks: executive health, release, application, infrastructure, security, and database. Wire alarms to on\-call.
* Run the failure playbooks: platform outage, one customer unavailable, a capacity spike, a background\-job backlog, database pressure, Redis pressure, a failed migration, a failed deploy, a security finding, a backup failure, and a regional outage.
* Take part in on\-call for production alarms and release windows.
* Use investigation aids, including AI summaries, as input only. Rollbacks outside the pre\-approved bake rule, scaling, database changes, and customer messages stay human\-approved.



  





**Qualifications and Skills** 



* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, comfortable diagnosing issues across systems
* Clear communicator, able to translate technical incidents into plain language for non\-technical stakeholders
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with shifting priorities
* Level C1 or above English proficiency
* Detail\-oriented with a bias toward proactive monitoring over reactive firefighting



  





**Experience and Skills Required** 



* Experience in a production operations, DevOps\-adjacent, or technical support role, ideally within a SaaS or platform environment
* Familiarity with monitoring and alerting tools (e.g. Datadog, Grafana, or similar) is a plus
* Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS or similar) is beneficial
* Exposure to manufacturing or industrial software environments is a plus, but not required
* Experience in production operations, SRE, or technical support for a SaaS or platform product.
* Hands\-on familiarity with Amazon CloudWatch (metrics, alarms, logs, and synthetics) and Grafana. Prometheus and tracing (X\-Ray or OpenTelemetry) are a plus.
* Working knowledge of AWS: a load balancer, ECS or EC2, RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis, and a deployment that can roll back.
* Comfortable running an incident: severity, an incident channel, a runbook, and a clear update for the customer.
* Exposure to manufacturing, ERP, or shop\-floor software is a plus
* Experience in production operations, SRE, or technical support for a SaaS or platform product.
* Hands\-on support of a Node.js and React application in production: Node.js API logs and errors, React client failures, and background workers.



  





**Interview Process** 





 Candidates who progress will be invited to a multi\-stage interview process, including a scenario\-based troubleshooting exercise.
 




  





**Contact** 





 If you're interested, please send your resume and introduction to careers@novatro.ai. Subject line: "ProdOps \- \[Your Name]". 
 





 We look forward to hearing from you!

 Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote

 0–2 years
 



**Reports to:** 
 Security Manager / CISO
 


 About the role
 
 You'll split your time between hands\-on security research and helping us build out our ISO 27001 Information Security Management System (ISMS). This is a role for someone early in their career who wants breadth: one week you might be tearing apart a vendor's product in a lab, the next you're mapping Annex A controls to what we actually do and chasing down evidence for an audit. You'll get mentorship from senior security engineers and a direct line to how a real certification programme gets built.
 


 What you'll do
 
**Security research** 



* Research, test, and benchmark security tools (vulnerability scanners, SAST/DAST, EDR, SIEM, secrets detection, cloud posture tooling) and write up clear recommendations on what we should adopt and why.

* Reproduce and validate published vulnerabilities in a controlled setting to understand exploitability in our context.

**ISO 27001 implementation support** 



* Support the rollout of the ISMS against ISO 27001:2022, including scoping, the Statement of Applicability, and the 93 Annex A controls.
* Draft and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and records under the guidance of the ISMS owner.
* Help maintain the risk register: assist with risk identification, assessment, treatment plans, and periodic review.
* Collect, organise, and validate evidence for internal audits, management reviews, and external certification audits.

* Assist with gap assessments, supplier security assessments, and security awareness training material.


 What we're looking for
 * 0–2 years in security, IT, or a related technical role. Internships, co\-ops, lab work, CTFs, bug bounty, and serious self\-study all count.
* Working understanding of core security concepts: the CIA triad, common vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10\), authentication and access control, encryption basics, and network fundamentals.
* Comfortable in Linux and with at least one scripting language (Python preferred) for automating repetitive analysis.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, or with any comparable control framework (SOC 2, NIST CSF, CIS Controls). Deep experience isn't expected; genuine interest is.
* Strong written English. A good portion of this job is turning technical findings into documents other people can use.
* Organised and able to track many small open items without dropping them, which is most of what audit readiness is.
* Curiosity and a willingness to say "I don't know yet, let me go find out."


 Nice to have
 * Certifications such as ISO 27001 Foundation or Lead Implementer, CompTIA Security\+, eJPT, or a cloud security associate cert.
* Exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with a GRC platform, or with tools like Burp Suite, Nmap, Wireshark, Nessus/OpenVAS.
* A home lab, personal write\-ups, CTF placings, or open\-source contributions.


 What we offer
 
 Competitive Salary along with benefits.
 


 How to apply
 
 Submit your CV. If you have write\-ups, a blog, a GitHub profile, or CTF results, include them. A short note about a security topic you've recently gone down a rabbit hole on is welcome and will be read.

title: IT Analyst
description:
**Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team**
 As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Investigate and respond to security alerts and incidents, performing root cause analysis and driving corrective actions.
* Lead and support incident response efforts, coordinating across teams to contain and remediate threats.
* Continuously improve detection and response processes through automation, runbook development, and SOP creation.
* Identify and strengthen threat detection and prevention capabilities.
* Integrate threat intelligence into operational workflows to proactively address emerging threats.
* Collaborate with Security, IT, and Business teams to enhance readiness and resilience through joint response planning.


**What You’ll Need To Succeed**
* Extensive experience in Security Operations and Incident Response, with a strong track record of handling complex incidents.
* Proficiency with modern cybersecurity tools (EDR, SIEM, firewalls, WAF, identity, and cloud security platforms).
* Experience operationalizing threat intelligence and developing detection strategies for evolving threats.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a focus on process rigor and continuous improvement.
* Ability to drive action and influence outcomes in fast\-paced, cross\-functional environments.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team\-first mindset and mentoring capabilities.


**Required**
**What we look for:**
* 1–3 years in a SOC, incident response, IT security operations, or adjacent role (e.g., EDR admin, blue team intern/co\-op).
* Experience with at least one of: SIEM, EDR/XDR, secure email gateway, cloud security tools (M365 Defender suite, Defender for Endpoint, Sentinel, Splunk, CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, Zscaler, etc.).

**Preferred**

 3–5 Years

 The candidate should have strong practical knowledge of penetration testing methodologies and modern security tools, along with the ability to leverage

 .

 .
* Good understanding of

 .

 .

 **Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, and cloud\-native SaaS environments** 
 .

 **multi\-tenant SaaS applications and APIs** 
 .

**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, safer AI systems — and we need practitioners who truly understand how cloud environments fail in the real world.
   

  

 If you've spent time in the trenches of AWS, GCP, or Azure and you know what a misconfigured IAM policy or an exposed storage bucket actually means for a business, this role was built for you. Your expertise will directly shape how AI reasons about cloud security — making these systems more accurate, more realistic, and more useful.

* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze cloud security scenarios across AWS, GCP, and Azure to identify risks and realistic failure patterns
* Review IAM configurations, network architectures, storage permissions, and container security setups
* Classify security gaps, misconfigurations, and cloud incidents based on real\-world impact and blast radius
* Validate and improve AI\-generated security reasoning so it reflects how cloud incidents actually unfold
* Help build datasets and evaluations that push the frontier of AI security capabilities


**Who You Are**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience working with cloud environments in production
* Solid understanding of cloud IAM, networking, storage, and container security across major providers
* Familiar with real\-world misconfigurations and how they escalate into incidents
* Able to reason clearly about blast radius, risk exposure, and business impact
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task\-based assignments


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with cloud security tooling (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, AWS Security Hub)
* Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or incident response
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, or NIST
* Security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, CISSP, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on frontier AI systems with top research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Meaningful work that improves how AI understands real\-world security
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Respiratory Therapist Specialist - Apprenticeship
description:
**Respiratory Therapist Specialist \- Apprenticeship**
======================================================

Date: Sep 22, 2026
Location:
Chennai, IN Bengaluru, IN
Company: Getinge Medical India Pvt. Ltd.
Remote Work:  

**With a passion for life**

  

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life\-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.


Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

  

**Job Overview**


The Respiratory Therapist Specialist – Apprentice program is designed for fresh graduates aspiring to build a career in respiratory care and mechanical ventilation technology. As part of a leading healthcare/medical device organization, the apprentice will receive intensive training on mechanical ventilators, and other respiratory care devices while supporting clinical teams in hospitals. This is a structured learning role with strong exposure to real\-world clinical workflows, device handling, and interaction with ICU/critical care staff.


**Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties**


**Clinical \& Technical Learning**


* Learn the fundamentals of mechanical ventilation, respiratory parameters, and device operations.
* Assist senior respiratory therapists and application specialists during ventilator demonstrations, installations, and clinical support sessions.
* Observe and assist with ventilator setup, configuration, and monitoring in ICU.
* Understand different ventilation modes (e.g., Volume Control, Pressure Control, SIMV, CPAP).

**Application \& Customer Support**


* Support in conducting product demos and hands\-on training for clinicians and nurses.
* Assist in troubleshooting basic device issues under guidance from senior team members.
* Learn how to document feedback, clinical observations, and usage patterns from hospitals.

**Device Management \& Compliance**


* Help in performing routine checks, preventive maintenance, and performance assessments of ventilators.
* Ensure proper cleaning, handling, and safety protocols for all respiratory devices.
* Follow company SOPs, regulatory guidelines, and hospital infection control norms.

**Training \& Certification**


* Participate in structured internal training programs on respiratory therapy and ventilator technology.
* Complete skill assessments, modules, and certification milestones during the apprenticeship period.

**Minimum Requirements**


* **Education (Freshers Only)**:
  

o Bachelor’s Degree in: Respiratory Therapy / Respiratory Care
* **Preferred Knowledge:**
  

o Basic understanding of Human Respiratory physiology
  

o Interest in mechanical ventilation and critical care devices
  

o Comfort working in hospital/ICU environments

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**


* Strong learning mindset and passion for respiratory care
* Good communication and interpersonal skills for hospital interactions
* Technical curiosity for medical devices and technology
* Ability to work under supervision in fast paced clinical settings
* Willingness to travel locally for hospital visits

**Benefits \& Growth Opportunities**


* Hands\-on training with advanced ventilator systems and respiratory technology
* Exposure to real hospital environments, ICU workflows, and critical care teams
* Mentorship from experienced respiratory therapists and application experts
* Certificate of Apprenticeship upon completion
* Strong career pathway into:
  

o Respiratory Therapist
  

o Application Specialist – Ventilators
  

o Clinical Specialist – Critical Care
  

o Product Trainer / Clinical Educator
  

o Technical Support Specialist (Medical Devices)

\#Li\-SN2

  

**About us**

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

  

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: IP Admin Senior Analyst
description:
We are looking for someone to join our IP Admin Team at Noida. This position exists to process correspondences issued by United States Patent \& Trademark office (PTO or USPTO), patent offices worldwide and the filing documents submitted in PTO during the patent \& trademarks life cycle. The main purpose of the role is to review, docket, de\-docket information received from PTOs, law firms, agents, and clients into Intellectual property management system (IPMS) and routing the said information to the appropriate attorneys or paralegals for action.


This is an exciting opportunity to work in the IP field where\-in, self\-improvement initiatives to drive client delight, building capability are added learnings.


We are the largest Intellectual Property Administrative service provider.

 **Experience, Education, Skills, and Accomplishments**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. B.Com, BBA, BCA, BA, MBA graduates with minimum 50% aggregate
* Freshers from 2025\-2026 Batch
* Experienced candidates should have a minimum of 18 months of work experience in Backend Operations
* Confident and proactive team player, with good interpersonal skills
* Ability to work independently and efficiently with minimum / no supervision.

 **It would be great if you also had . . .**

* IP Knowledge with experience to work on different IPMS' is added advantage and preferable.
* Good written \& verbal communication skills
* Basic MS office: Proficiency in Microsoft office suite programs, including Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
* Strong analytical skills to comprehensively evaluate the data.

 **What will you be doing in this role?**

* Docketing: calendaring the statutory \& non\-statutory deadlines in Intellectual Property Management System (IPMS) along with relevant documents to preserve IP rights.
* De\-docketing: perform or close the calendared events in IPMS once the requisite action is completed or cancelled, respectively.
* Prioritize daily docketing/de\-docketing requests and other allocated tasks as agreed with client to complete in each day to keep IPMS current and correct.
* Review patent \& trademarks prosecution related documents (US \& Non\-US) received via mail or shared site and update / create the records in IPMS as per the standard operating procedures (SOPs).
* Create and update patent \& trademarks records in IPMS along with family linking of direct and subject matter related (SMR) applications.
* Effective communication with Attorneys, Paralegals, Law firms, foreign agents, and other stake holders to seek instructions and clarification on certain tasks.
* Maintain the data integrity of IPMS and proactively monitoring the docket to ensure that all PTO \& client deadlines are met.
* Facilitate timely filing of all patent and trademarks application \& office action response through order letters and other required instructions.
* Facilitate accurate and timely payment of all PTO fees including the maintenance fees, coordinate with client for payment instructions and coordinate with annuity service providers or law firms.
* Abreast of changes in PTO guidelines and procedures and extend support to team with process related inputs.
* Training: Providing OJT’s to new joiners, conducting refresher trainings.
* Audits: Ability to perform internal and PTO Audits is preferred
* Quality Check: Should be able perform docketing Quality audits
* 1st level query resolution

 **About the Team**


The team consists of 10\-15 members and is reporting to the Manager Operations.


Core process related responsibilities: IP docketing is the process of tracking deadlines related to the prosecution of patents, trademarks, and copyrights before their respective governing offices. This includes interacting with clients including external vendors \- Law firms, Annuity service providers etc., Quality Auditors, IP Operations function heads, Continuous Improvement team.

Provis Technologies Private Limited is a Jaipur\-based technology company delivering AI\-powered SaaS products, e\-commerce solutions, mobile applications and custom software\-development services.

We work with businesses in India and international markets to help them improve operations, customer experience and growth through technology.

Job Summary

We are looking for a confident and proactive Business Development Executive who can introduce our products and services to potential clients, conduct outbound calls, qualify leads, schedule meetings and maintain consistent follow\-ups.

The candidate will also contact registered attendees and prospective participants before exhibitions, conferences, webinars and business events. Responsibilities will include confirming attendance, introducing Provis, identifying relevant business requirements and scheduling meetings for the event.

This position also includes sales operations work such as maintaining CRM records, organising lead databases, preparing reports, coordinating meetings and ensuring timely follow\-ups.

This is a calling and execution\-focused role. Candidates who are uncomfortable with outbound calling should not apply.

Key ResponsibilitiesClient Prospecting and Outreach

* Research potential clients, companies and decision\-makers.
* Generate leads through LinkedIn, email, cold calling, online research, business directories, referrals and events.
* Make outbound calls to introduce Provis products and services.
* Send personalised emails, LinkedIn messages and follow\-up communication.
* Understand the prospect’s business, challenges and initial requirements.
* Qualify leads based on need, authority, budget, timeline and solution fit.
* Schedule discovery calls, product demonstrations and business meetings.
* Maintain consistent follow\-ups until a clear outcome is received.
* Build professional relationships with prospective clients.

Product and Service Sales Support

* Develop a working understanding of Provis products and services.
* Explain AI, SaaS, e\-commerce and software solutions in simple business language.
* Identify which Provis product or service may be relevant to each prospect.
* Coordinate product demonstrations with technical and leadership teams.
* Prepare meeting briefs, company profiles, presentations and basic proposals.
* Record client requirements, questions, objections and agreed next steps.
* Support the sales team throughout the opportunity\-development process.

Event Attendee Outreach

* Work with event attendee, exhibitor and prospect databases.
* Call registered or shortlisted attendees before conferences, exhibitions, webinars and networking events.
* Introduce Provis and explain the purpose of connecting at the event.
* Confirm attendance and identify interested prospects.
* Schedule meetings with qualified attendees before the event.
* Maintain an organised event meeting calendar.
* Send meeting confirmations, reminders and relevant company information.
* Coordinate with internal team members attending the event.
* Follow up with attendees and leads after the event.
* Update event leads, meeting outcomes and next actions in the CRM.

Sales Operations and Coordination

* Maintain accurate prospect and client records in the CRM or tracking system.
* Update call status, lead stage, meeting notes, follow\-up date and next action.
* Clean, organise and segment lead databases.
* Manage meeting schedules and reminders.
* Prepare daily and weekly activity reports.
* Track calls, responses, qualified leads, meetings, proposals and conversions.
* Coordinate with management, marketing, design, product and technical teams.
* Support proposal preparation and sales documentation.
* Ensure that no qualified opportunity is lost because of delayed follow\-up.
* Assist with other business\-development and sales\-operational tasks when required.

Required Skills

* Good spoken and written English
* Confidence in making outbound calls
* Clear and professional telephone communication
* Good listening, questioning and follow\-up skills
* Basic understanding of B2B sales and lead generation
* Interest in AI, SaaS, e\-commerce and IT services
* Ability to research companies and decision\-makers
* Strong coordination and organisational skills
* Working knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets, email and presentation tools
* Ability to maintain accurate CRM and call records
* Ability to understand technical offerings and explain their business value
* Target\-oriented and comfortable with measurable performance expectations
* Responsible, disciplined and willing to take ownership

Preferred Skills

* Previous experience in inside sales, business development, telesales or client outreach
* Experience selling software, SaaS, e\-commerce solutions or IT services
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Experience using CRM and email\-outreach tools
* Experience calling domestic or international prospects
* Knowledge of event outreach or appointment setting
* Experience coordinating meetings, calendars and follow\-up activities
* Familiarity with AI tools for prospect research and outreach personalisation

Candidate EligibilityInterns and Freshers

Interns and freshers may apply if they have:

* Strong communication skills
* Confidence in speaking with new people
* Genuine interest in technology sales
* Basic computer and spreadsheet knowledge
* Good research and learning ability
* Discipline to perform daily outreach and follow\-ups
* Willingness to learn CRM, sales operations and client communication

Relevant internships, certifications, college projects, event coordination or sales activities will be considered.

Candidates With 1–3 Years of Experience

Experienced candidates should be able to:

* Independently research and build prospect lists
* Make outbound calls without constant supervision
* Qualify leads and handle initial conversations
* Schedule meetings and product demonstrations
* Manage assigned prospects and follow\-ups
* Coordinate pre\-event and post\-event outreach
* Maintain accurate CRM and sales reports
* Demonstrate measurable results from previous sales or lead\-generation work

Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number of relevant prospects researched
* Outbound calls and meaningful conversations completed
* Qualified leads generated
* Meetings and product demonstrations scheduled
* Event attendees contacted and meetings confirmed
* Outreach response rate
* Lead\-to\-meeting conversion rate
* Follow\-up consistency
* CRM accuracy and data quality
* Proposals and business opportunities created
* Contribution to sales pipeline and revenue

Submitting random contact lists or completing calls without meaningful qualification will not be considered successful performance.

Educational Qualifications

Candidates with qualifications such as MBA, PGDM, BBA, B.Com, B.Tech, BCA, MCA or degrees in Sales, Marketing, Business Management, IT or related fields may apply.

Practical ability, communication, discipline and ownership will receive greater weight than academic qualifications alone.

Application Requirements

Candidates should submit:

* Updated resume
* Current location
* Current and expected salary or stipend
* Notice period or joining availability
* Relevant calling, sales or business\-development experience
* Familiarity with AI, SaaS, e\-commerce or IT services
* A short response to the following:

**How would you approach potential clients and event attendees to generate qualified meetings for Provis Technologies?**

Important

* This is a full\-time, work\-from\-office position in Jaipur.
* The role requires regular outbound calling and follow\-ups.
* Candidates must be comfortable working with activity and outcome\-based targets.

It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.

**Position Overview****:**
The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose****:**
To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

 **Key** **Roles \& Responsibilities****:****Pickup \& Delivery Operations*** Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.
 **Customer Service Excellence*** Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.
 **COD \& Documentation Management*** Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.
 **Operational** **Compliance*** Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.
 **Safety \& Security*** Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.
 **Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility*** Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.
 **Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation*** Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.
 **Team Collaboration*** Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.
 **Qualifications \& Experience:****Education**:* Minimum **8th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.
 **Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.
 **Eligibility Requirements****:*** Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.
 **Skills \& Capabilities:** **Technical Skills:*** Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding
**Key Competencies:*** Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance
 **Key Performance Indicators:** **KRAs**

 **KPIs**

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency

title: Support Technician
description:
Support Technician \| scanO

Company: Trismus Healthcare Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (scanO)

Location: Pune, Corporate Office

Employment Type: Full\-time, On\-site

Reports To: Head of Customer Support / Operations

Working Days: 6 days per week  
Schedule: Monday–Saturday or Sunday–Friday, based on team allocation

About scanO

scanO builds AI\-powered oral health screening solutions for dental clinics, including scanO air, our screening unit; scanO engage, our practitioner platform; and scanO care, our patient app.

Over 400 units are live across clinics in India, the UK, UAE, and South Africa. When something does not work, clinics rely on our support team. How quickly and effectively we resolve those issues directly impacts their experience with scanO.

Role Overview

We are looking for a technically strong and customer\-focused Support Technician to join our support desk.

Clinics will reach out through email, phone, and WhatsApp with issues ranging from “the scan will not start” to “this AI report looks incorrect.”

You will diagnose issues, resolve what you can remotely, escalate technical problems to the appropriate engineer or field technician, and follow through until the clinic is operational again.

You will also maintain accurate records of our installed device fleet and help convert real customer issues into actionable feedback for our product, engineering, ML, and clinical teams.

This is a technical support role, not a call centre role. You should be able to understand how the device, application, and network work together well enough to isolate and troubleshoot faults remotely.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Own the Support Queue

Respond to support requests received through support@scanoai.com, phone, and WhatsApp within defined response timelines. Log every issue, maintain accurate statuses, and close the loop with the clinic.

2\. Diagnose Issues Remotely

Troubleshoot device, application, connectivity, and user\-related issues through phone, chat, and screen sharing. Reproduce issues wherever possible before escalating them.

3\. Escalate \& Follow Through

Raise clear and reproducible bug reports for the engineering team, including logs, unit ID, firmware version, and reproduction steps. Track escalations until resolution and keep the customer informed.

4\. Coordinate Field Service

Coordinate technician visits, part replacements, and unit returns with the operations team. Track units from pickup through service and redeployment.

5\. Maintain the Fleet Record

Keep accurate records of installed units, including clinic details, unit serial numbers, firmware versions, warranty status, open faults, and service history.

6\. Report AI Output Corrections

Collect cases where clinicians dispute or correct AI\-generated reports and share them with the ML and clinical teams, along with relevant images and context.

7\. Identify Recurring Patterns

Prepare a weekly summary covering support volumes, recurring faults, and major issue drivers to help the team address root causes instead of individual symptoms.

8\. Build the Knowledge Base

Create and maintain troubleshooting guides, FAQs, and clinic\-facing how\-to documentation as the product evolves.

9\. Support the Field Team

Provide remote technical assistance during installations, camps, demos, inaugurations, and escalations.

Requirements

Diploma or degree in Engineering, IT, Computer Science, or a related technical field

1–3 years of experience in technical support, service desk, field service, or device support

Strong freshers with demonstrated technical aptitude may also be considered

Comfortable troubleshooting hardware, mobile/web applications, Wi\-Fi, and basic networking

Clear spoken and written English and Hindi

Marathi or another regional language is an advantage

Ability to explain technical solutions clearly to dentists, receptionists, and other non\-technical users

Ability to remain calm and professional while handling frustrated customers

Strong discipline around issue logging, ownership, follow\-ups, and closure

Comfortable using spreadsheets and ticketing/CRM tools

Nice to Have

Experience with medical, diagnostic, or imaging devices

Familiarity with Zoho CRM/Helpdesk or similar tools

Basic understanding of computer vision or AI model outputs

Willingness to travel occasionally for installations or escalations

* Internet reimbursement
* Paid time off

title: Sales Associate
description:
**Job description:**

Selling enterprise technology to banks is not straightforward. Buying cycles are long, stakeholders are multiple, and the product requires genuine understanding to sell well. We are looking for someone who can research accounts deeply, hold credible conversations with IT and risk teams, manage a process with discipline, and close. A background in CS or IT gives you an edge here \- you will not be reading from a script.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Prospecting and Pipeline**

* Identify key decision\-makers across IT, risk, compliance, and operations functions.
* Research target banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions \- understand their technology stack, current fraud challenges, regulatory pressures, and buying signals.
* Build and manage a pipeline of qualified opportunities from outbound outreach to close.
* Maintain clean, up\-to\-date records in the CRM. Pipeline hygiene is nonnegotiable.

**Outreach and Engagement**

* Run structured outbound campaigns via email, LinkedIn, and phone to open new conversations.
* Send relevant product collaterals and updates to prospects at the right moment in their buying journey.
* Follow up with consistency and purpose \- not with noise.

**Discovery and Demos**

* Conduct discovery calls to understand a prospect's fraud and compliance challenges, existing systems, and decision timelines.
* Coordinate and support product demonstrations \- ideally understanding the product well enough to handle most technical questions yourself.
* Prepare tailored pre\-call briefs and post\-call summaries with clear next steps.

**Proposals and Closing**

* Work with internal teams to respond to RFPs, RFIs, and proof\-of\-concept requests.
* Prepare proposals, capability documents, and commercial summaries for prospects.
* Track deal milestones and drive each opportunity towards a decision with a structured process.

**Events and Industry Presence**

* Identify and attend banking and fintech industry events, conferences, and regulatory forums where target buyers are present.
* Represent IntelleWings in face\-to\-face settings with confidence and credibility.

**Intelligence and Feedback**

* Feed market intelligence \- competitor observations, buyer objections, product gaps \- back to the product and leadership teams regularly.
* Contribute to the improvement of sales materials, decks, and outreach templates based on what is working in the field.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering discipline. MBA from a top b\-school is an added advantage. You need to understand what you are selling.
* 0\-2 years of experience. We will consider freshers with strong communication skills and a demonstrable ability to research and structure their thinking.
* Prior experience in a technology company \- either in a technical role or in sales \- is a strong advantage.
* You communicate clearly, both in writing and in conversation. Banker audiences are formal \- your instincts need to match.
* You are process\-oriented. You keep notes, track follow\-ups, and do not let things fall through.
* You are analytically minded. You can read a product MIS report, understand what it says, and use it in a sales conversation.
* You do not need everything to be handed to you. Research, initiative, and intellectual curiosity matter here.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Exposure to banking, fintech, or regulatory technology \- through work, internships, or serious personal interest.
* Experience with enterprise sales cycles, even if at an early stage.
* Familiarity with fraud risk, AML, or compliance concepts.
* Working knowledge of a CRM tool.

**ABOUT INTELLEWINGS**

IntelleWings builds AML \& Mule Detection Solutions for banks and financial institutions. Our platform processes hundreds of millions of transactions in real time and is live at some of India's largest banks. We are a small, technical team selling a serious product to serious buyers \- and growing really fast.

The Sales Executive is responsible for achieving assigned sales targets, developing the customer base, increasing product distribution, maintaining good relationships with retailers and distributors, and ensuring effective market coverage within the assigned area.

description:
**Company Name**:The Akanksha Foundation.

**Overview Of the Company:**

The Akanksha Foundation is a non\-profit organization with a mission to provide children from low\-income communities with a high\-quality education, enabling them to maximize their potential and transform their lives. Akanksha works primarily in the field of education, addressing formal education by initiating school reform through its School Project. Currently, Akanksha reaches out to the 13000\+ children through its 26 schools in Mumbai, Pune and Nagpur.

**Position:** Primary Teacher (Marathi)

**Compensation**: Rs. 33,000/\- to Rs. 36,000/\-

**Reports to:** School Leader

**Position Summary**: As an Akanksha teacher, you will be directly responsible for at least 30 kids in a class. Your role will be to guide the students towards academic achievement while inculcating self\-esteem and values in their curriculum that will empower them to think critically and make informed choices in their life. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. You will build strong bonds with children to understand each child’s needs and work with parents as partners in their child’s education and future. Overview of the Team: The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai and Pune. These schools work in partnership with local municipalities, with the vision of creating small clusters of model schools in these cities that can be used to impact the mainstream education system. The School Team comprises teachers, social workers, school administrator and helpers led by the School Leader.

● Teaching the Akanksha curriculum through effective pedagogical practices

● Designing and executing lesson plans that will engage students

● Providing a positive environment to engage students in the learning process

● Strong content knowledge and expertise

● Adaptability to new instructional approaches

● Patience and capacity to solve problems

● Strong team player

● Self\-motivated with strong work ethics to achieve school goals

● Openness to feedback and critical reflection
