* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

  

COD \& Documentation Management* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

  

Operational Compliance* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

  

Safety \& Security* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

  

Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

  

Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

  

Team Collaboration* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.

  

Qualifications \& Experience:
Education:* Minimum 8th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

  

Experience:* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

  

Eligibility Requirements:* Minimum age 18 years.
* Valid Two\-Wheeler or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

  

Skills \& Capabilities:  

Technical Skills:* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding


Key Competencies:* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance

  

Key Performance Indicators:  

KRAs KPIs
Delivery \& Pickup Performance On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity
Service Quality First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction
COD \& Documentation COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors
Safety \& Compliance Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance
Operational Productivity Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency  

Why join DHL Blue Dart?
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
Here’s what makes us stand out:* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* Competitive pay and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best\-in\-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.


This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. Come grow with us.

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).

● Tag every cancellation against a defined reason category (price, availability, distance, doubt about the clinic, resolved elsewhere, etc.).

● Attempt recovery wherever possible — rescheduling, suggesting an alternate clinic, slot, or partner.

● Share recurring patterns and user feedback with the vertical and operations teams so the underlying issues can be fixed.

**3\. Call Volume \& Pipeline Discipline**

● Deliver a minimum of 100 outbound calls per day consistently.

● Contact every new booking within the defined turnaround time (TAT).

● Keep the follow\-up pipeline clean — no lead left untouched beyond its due date.

**4\. CRM \& Reporting**

● Log every call with an accurate disposition, notes, and next action in the CRM.

● Maintain daily call and conversion trackers.

● Submit a daily productivity report and share weekly insights on common objections and drop\-off reasons.

**5\. Coordination**

● Work with clinic partners, physiotherapists, and the internal operations team to confirm slots, availability, and appointment scheduling.

● Escalate service issues and unhappy users promptly to the right team.

**Success Metrics (KPIs)**

● Consultation\-to\-procedure conversion rate (dental)

● Consultation\-to\-session/package conversion rate (physiotherapy)

● Number of calls per day (minimum 100\) and connect rate

● Cancellation recovery / rescheduling rate

● First\-call TAT on new bookings

● CRM data accuracy and completeness

**Required Skills**

● **Excellent communication skills** — fluent, clear, confident spoken English with a neutral accent.

● **High call capacity** — comfortable and consistent with making at least 100 calls a day.

● **Persuasion and objection handling** — able to make a case without being pushy.

● **Active listening** — able to hear what the user is actually worried about, especially while probing cancellation reasons.

● **Empathy and patience** — users are discussing health concerns, sometimes anxious ones; tone matters.

● **Target orientation and resilience** — able to stay motivated through rejection and hit daily and monthly numbers.

● **Attention to detail** — accurate, honest call logging; the data drives business decisions.

● **Basic tech comfort** — Google Sheets / MS Excel, CRM tools, and cloud telephony / auto\-dialer systems.

● **Time management** — able to structure a day around fresh leads, follow\-ups, and cancellation calls without dropping any bucket.

● **Integrity** — never over\-promise clinical outcomes or misrepresent pricing; healthcare trust is non\-negotiable.

**Good to Have**

● Working knowledge of Hindi and/or a regional language.

● Prior experience in inside sales, telecalling, customer support, or a BPO environment (internships count).

● Exposure to healthcare, health insurance, wellness, or diagnostics.

● Familiarity with CRM platforms

● Basic understanding of dental and physiotherapy terminology, or a strong willingness to learn it quickly.

**Eligibility**

● 0–1 year of experience; freshers with strong communication skills are welcome.

description:
**INTTEGRIA GLOBAL PARTNER**

*Integrated Intelligence. Tangible Transformation.*

**Accountant — Entry Level (Freshers)**

Dedicated Accountant Track \| D\-AOX Delivery Team \| Full\-Time

**1\. ROLE SNAPSHOT**

**Job Title**

Accountant — Entry Level (Fresher)

**Internal Track**

Dedicated Accountant (AOX) — D\-AOX Delivery Framework

**Department**

Financial Operations \& Client Delivery

**Reports To**

Senior Accountant / Delivery Manager — Dedicated Accountant Vertical

**Experience**

0–1 year (freshers encouraged to apply)

**Qualification**

Bachelor's degree mandatory; Post\-graduate degree preferred

**Employment Type**

Full\-Time, Permanent

**Work Mode**

Work from office (Bengaluru) / Hybrid as per client allocation

**Working Days**

Monday to Saturday (alternate Saturdays off)

**Compensation**

As per industry standards \+ performance\-linked incentives

**Probation**

6 months, with structured training and evaluation

**2\. ABOUT INTTEGRIA GLOBAL PARTNER**

Inttegria Global Partner is a Financial Intelligence Organisation. We do not sell isolated compliance filings — we deliver integrated financial and business intelligence to growing organisations through our proprietary IIFTS (Integrated Intelligence Financial Transformation System) framework.

Our services span three verticals: National and Global Professional Services; Audit, Accounting and Compliance; and an Online Startup Platform. Within these, our Dedicated Accountant (AOX) programme embeds a named accountant inside a client organisation as a Virtual CFO\-equivalent resource — dedicated, not rotating; measured, not assumed; proactive, not on\-request.

**Why this matters for a fresher**

You will not be filed away in a back\-office data\-entry seat. From day one you are assigned to live client books under the D\-AOX responsibility framework, with a structured 8\-point progression from Business Understanding through to Evaluation and Accountability. This is a career path into Virtual CFO and financial advisory work, not a bookkeeping dead end.

**3\. PURPOSE OF THE ROLE**

The Entry\-Level Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate, real\-time books for allocated client accounts and supporting the Dedicated Accountant team in delivering the full D\-AOX responsibility cycle. The role exists to ensure that every client's financial data is clean, current and reconciled — so that the intelligence layer built on top of it (reconciliations, budget forecasts, RTI dashboards and advisory) is reliable.

**4\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES4\.1 Daily and Recurring Accounting Operations**

▪ Record day\-to\-day accounting entries — sales, purchases, journals, receipts, payments and contra — in the client's accounting software with correct ledger classification.

▪ Maintain complete bookkeeping for allocated client accounts, ensuring books are closed and current on a real\-time or agreed cycle basis.

▪ Perform bank, vendor, customer and inter\-company reconciliations; identify, investigate and clear differences.

▪ Manage Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable ageing — track outstanding invoices, follow up on collections and schedule payables.

▪ Prepare and issue sales invoices, credit and debit notes, and maintain supporting documentation.

▪ Track and classify business expenses, validate supporting bills, and flag policy or budget deviations.

▪ Assist in cash flow tracking and daily / weekly fund position reporting.

**4\.2 Compliance and Statutory Support**

▪ Prepare GST working sheets and assist in GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B and GSTR\-9 filings; support Input Tax Credit (ITC) reconciliation against GSTR\-2A / 2B.

▪ Assist with TDS computation, challan preparation, payment and quarterly return filing via TRACES.

▪ Support payroll processing inputs, PF/ESI workings and Professional Tax compliance.

▪ Compile data and schedules for statutory audit, tax audit and annual ITR filing from the year's Profit \& Loss.

▪ Maintain compliance calendars for allocated clients and escalate due dates well in advance.

**4\.3 Reporting, Analysis and Client Support**

▪ Prepare monthly MIS packs — Trial Balance, Profit \& Loss, Balance Sheet and ageing schedules — for senior review.

▪ Populate and maintain client data in Real\-Time Intelligence (RTI) dashboards and the Financial Data Repository (FDR).

▪ Support budget preparation and variance analysis against actuals.

▪ Maintain organised digital records and audit trails for every client engagement.

▪ Participate in client calls alongside the Dedicated Accountant to understand business context, finance patterns and industry\-specific treatment.

**5\. TECHNICAL SKILLS REQUIRED**

Candidates are not expected to be expert in every tool listed. The "Must Have" column defines the entry bar; the remainder are trained in\-house during probation.

**5\.1 Accounting \& ERP Software**

Trainable

Must Have

Bulk return preparation and reconciliation utilities

Preferred

PF and ESI return filing support

Trainable

**5\.3 Spreadsheet, Data \& Productivity Skills**

Must Have

Preferred

Sheets, Docs, Drive collaboration on shared client files

Must Have

Client reports, memos, MIS presentation decks

Must Have

**Power BI / Google Looker Studio**

RTI dashboard support and visual reporting

Good to Have

**AI productivity tools**

Responsible use for drafting, reconciliation checks and research

Good to Have

**5\.4 Domain Knowledge**

▪ Sound grasp of accounting fundamentals — double\-entry, accrual vs cash basis, journal to final accounts flow.

▪ Working understanding of Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS / AS) at a conceptual level.

▪ Basic working knowledge of GST law — supply, place of supply, ITC eligibility, reverse charge.

▪ Basic working knowledge of the Income Tax Act as applicable to TDS and business income.

▪ Familiarity with the Companies Act 2013 statutory reporting requirements (conceptual).

**6\. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS6\.1 Bachelor's Degree — Mandatory**

A completed three\-year undergraduate degree from a recognised university is the minimum entry requirement.

**Accepted Degree**

**Notes**

**B.Com — General**

Most preferred; core accounting and taxation foundation

**B.Com — Accounting \& Finance / Computer Applications / Taxation**

Highly preferred; specialisation is an added advantage

**BBA / BBM — Finance or Accounting specialisation**

Accepted with demonstrated accounting coursework

**BMS — Finance**

Accepted

**B.A. Economics with accounting coursework**

Accepted on a case\-by\-case basis

**Any graduate pursuing CA / CMA / CS (Inter cleared)**

Strongly preferred — articleship or Inter\-level candidates welcome

**Minimum marks:** 50% aggregate in graduation. Candidates below this threshold with strong practical software skills may still be considered at the interview panel's discretion.

**6\.2 Post\-Graduate Degree — Preferred**

A post\-graduate qualification is not mandatory but carries direct weight in shortlisting, starting band placement and speed of progression into the Dedicated Accountant role.

**Accepted Qualification**

**Notes**

**M.Com**

Preferred — deepens accounting and taxation grounding

**MBA / PGDM — Finance**

Preferred — fast\-tracks toward Virtual CFO and advisory work

**M.Com — Accounting \& Finance / International Business**

Preferred

**CA (Inter / Final) — completed or pursuing**

Strongly preferred

**CMA (Inter / Final) — completed or pursuing**

Strongly preferred

**CS (Executive / Professional)**

Preferred for compliance\-heavy client allocation

**ACCA / CPA — part or fully qualified**

Preferred for global professional services engagements

**6\.3 Certifications — Added Advantage**

▪ Tally Prime certification (TallyACE / TallyPro) or equivalent.

▪ GST Practitioner or GST certification course from a recognised institute.

▪ Advanced Excel or Power BI certification.

▪ Zoho Books / QuickBooks ProAdvisor certification.

▪ Internship or articleship experience in a CA firm, audit firm or accounting BPO.

**7\. CORE COMPETENCIES \& BEHAVIOURAL EXPECTATIONS**

**Competency**

**What It Looks Like in This Role**

**Accuracy \& Attention to Detail**

Zero\-tolerance mindset on ledger classification, GSTIN entry and reconciliation differences

**Ownership**

Treats allocated client books as their own responsibility, not as tasks assigned

**Confidentiality**

Handles client financial data under strict non\-disclosure discipline

**Communication**

Clear written and verbal English; able to explain a figure to a non\-finance client contact

**Deadline Discipline**

Statutory due dates are non\-negotiable; plans backwards from them

**Learning Agility**

Picks up new software, industries and finance patterns quickly

**Analytical Thinking**

Asks why a number moved, not just what the number is

**Team Collaboration**

Works inside the D\-AOX delivery structure and escalates early

**Language:** English (professional working proficiency) is mandatory. Kannada, Hindi or Tamil is an added advantage for client interaction.

**8\. GROWTH PATH**

Inttegria runs a defined progression ladder for accounting talent. Movement is based on demonstrated capability against the D\-AOX responsibility framework, not on tenure alone.

**Stage**

**Typical Timeline**

**Scope**

**Accountant — Entry Level**

Year 0–1

Bookkeeping, reconciliation, compliance support under supervision

**Accountant — Associate**

Year 1–2

Independent client books, GST/TDS ownership, MIS preparation

**Dedicated Accountant (AOX)**

Year 2–4

Named accountant embedded with clients; full 10\-point D\-AOX responsibility cycle

**Senior / Lead Accountant**

Year 4–6

Multi\-client portfolio, team review, budget forecasting and advisory

**Virtual CFO — FOXIBOX**

Year 6\+

Strategic financial intelligence, transformation mandates, client leadership

**9\. WHAT WE OFFER**

▪ Structured onboarding and training on the IIFTS and D\-AOX frameworks from day one.

▪ Direct exposure to live client accounts across multiple industries — not siloed data entry.

▪ Mentorship from senior accountants, Virtual CFOs and compliance specialists.

▪ Support for CA / CMA / CS / ACCA study, including examination leave as per policy.

▪ Performance\-linked incentives tied to accuracy, turnaround and client retention metrics.

▪ A clearly published growth ladder with defined capability milestones.

**Equal Opportunity**

Inttegria Global Partner is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate every applicant on capability, integrity and potential — and on nothing else.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

description:

 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running.  Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.

title: IT Sales Executive
description:
IT Sales \- Job Description

IT sales consultants are sales professionals who specialize in selling computer hardware and software, as well as IT services. Success in this industry requires advanced knowledge of fundamental IT principles. IT sales professionals have to be able to answer highly technical questions in order to close sales. As the job title suggests, IT sales professionals are employed by companies within the IT industry. This includes companies that sell hardware, such as en user computing devices, servers, storage, networking and other products related to IT infra. It also includes selling software, which can be specific to an industry, such as healthcare or finance, ERP or cloud.

As an IT sales professional, you'll usually work with commercial clients, finding the right technological hardware and software products to suit their business needs.

The work of an IT sales professional falls into three main areas:

* pre\-sales \- giving detailed information about technical specifications and the ways in which they could meet a customer's needs
* sales \- negotiating a commercial agreement to the benefit of both the customer and supplier
* post\-sales (or after\-sales) \- generate inquiries for AMCs, support services etc

Responsibilities as an IT sales professional, you'll need to:

* speak to customers, either face to face or over the phone
* gain an understanding of customers' diverse and specific business needs and apply product knowledge to meet them
* ensure quality of service by developing a thorough and detailed knowledge of technical specifications and other features of employers' systems and processes, and then documenting them
* carry out cold\-calling in order to create interest in products and services, generate new business leads and arrange meetings
* identify and develop new business through networking and follow\-up courtesy calls
* prepare and deliver presentations and demonstrations of software to customers
* market and promote a portfolio of products by writing and designing sales literature and attending industry events
* maintain awareness and keep abreast of constantly changing software and hardware systems and peripherals (e.g. keyboard and mouse)
* develop effective sales plans using sales methodology
* provide technical advice to customers on all aspects of the installation and use of computer systems and networks, both before and after the sale
* advise on software features and how they can be applied to assist in a variety of contexts such as accounting, manufacturing or other specialist areas
* network with existing customers in order to maintain links and promote additional products and upgrades
* handle hardware or software problems and faults, referring on to specialist technical colleagues where appropriate
* respond to tender documents, proposals, reports and supporting literature
* manage workload in order to organise and prioritise daily and weekly goals
* contribute to team or progress meetings to update and inform colleagues.

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance

Experience:

* B2B sales: 2 years (Preferred)
* IT Sales: 1 year (Preferred)

description:
**About the Company** 




**Join the Rocketship 🚀** 




 We’re building
 **ShopOS** 
 —
 **AI agents powering the entire ecommerce stack.** 
 Already past PMF, we’re scaling fast and shaping the future of how online brands are built with AI. Co\-founded by seasoned builders with multiple successful exits to companies like
 **Flipkart** 
 and
 **Polygon Labs** 
 — and
 **backed by Binny Bansal** 
 — this isn’t just another start\-up. It’s your
 **front\-row seat to the next big shift in ecommerce.** 




  





**Watch** 
 :
 **What is ShopOS (from the founders’ lens \- Click here)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Workflow Engineer at ShopOS, you'll be responsible for building the backbone of automation that powers our AI\-native commerce stack — and then owning it. That means designing and implementing modular, node\-based workflow systems that integrate across catalog management, creative tools, personalization engines, and fulfillment systems, but it also means being the person who fixes them when they break, upgrades them as we scale, and documents them well enough that anyone on the team can pick them up.
 



 This role is for engineers who enjoy solving complex logic puzzles, who think in flows and systems rather than one\-off deliverables, and who want to make things smarter, faster, and more reliable — not just build them once and move on. You'll work closely with product, AI, and design teams to turn business rules into reusable, low\-code/no\-code automations that deliver outsized leverage to our users.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Build node\-based, rule\-driven workflows that support eCommerce operations and AI agent interactions
* Develop modular workflow components that can be composed into reusable, logic\-driven flows
* Integrate with APIs, data systems, and 3rd\-party services (Shopify, Stripe, Zapier, etc.)
* Diagnose and fix bugs in live workflows — including ones you didn't originally build
* Upgrade and refactor existing workflows for better reliability, speed, and cost
* Audit workflows on a regular cadence — flag fragile, redundant, or failure\-prone flows before they cause problems
* Maintain clear documentation for every workflow: what it does, what it depends on, what breaks it, how to fix it
* Set up admin interfaces and audit tools to monitor workflow health and performance
* Partner with product managers and designers to make workflows intuitive, testable, and transparent to end\-users
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to embed intelligence into decision points
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of key internal or external workflows (e.g. onboarding, content pipelines, personalization loops)
* Bring creative, non\-obvious solutions to recurring operational problems — not just the standard fix



**What We're Looking For** 



* CS background, with solid coding fundamentals
* Proficient in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Comfortable with Python for scripting and automation logic
* Hands\-on experience with node\-based / visual workflow builders (we currently run on Make; familiarity with n8n, Zapier, or similar counts too)
* Familiarity with Figma, Weavy, and ComfyUI
* Thinks in frameworks and systems rather than one\-off deliverables
* Strong debugging discipline — able to trace a failure across multiple connected systems, not just one node
* Comfortable with API integration (REST/GraphQL) and external services
* 2–4 years of experience — we're actively open to junior CS grads. Regardless of experience level, everyone gets trained on our systems, so raw fundamentals and problem\-solving instinct matter more than years on a resume



**Bonus Points** 



* Deep understanding of workflow engines, state machines, or rule engines
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and queueing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
* Working knowledge of Postgres and Redis
* Comfortable with infra\-as\-code (Docker, Terraform), monitoring, and CI/CD
* Experience with other low\-code/no\-code or visual workflow tools (Temporal, Langchain, Camunda, Retool)
* Exposure to AI/LLM systems and how workflows interface with prompt generation, chaining, etc.
* Previous experience in commerce, logistics, or creative ops automation
* Built internal ops tools or dashboards from scratch in a fast\-moving startup
* Familiarity with configuration\-driven or metadata\-driven engineering



**You'll Thrive If You Are…** 



* A builder who thinks in flows, states, and transitions
* Obsessed with making systems smarter, faster, and self\-healing
* Pragmatic about complexity — knowing when to write code and when to wire blocks
* Solution\-first — you show up with fixes, not just problem reports
* A team player who enjoys working across product, design, and AI teams
* Excited by the idea of creating leverage and automation for every human in the loop

title: Unity Developer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Unity Developer
 



**Department:** 
 Immersive Technologies
 



**Location:** 
 Vapi, Gujarat
 



**Experience:** 
 4–6 Years
 



**Job Purpose:** 




 To design, develop, and optimize interactive surgical training modules for a physics\-based robotic surgical training simulator built in Unity. The role will focus on developing C\#\-based training logic, interactive procedural workflows, soft\-body and deformable tissue interactions, custom shaders, physics systems, and real\-time simulation capabilities.
 



 The position will work closely with Unity Developers, Technical Artists, 3D Artists, Simulation Engineers, and Clinical SMEs to create a high\-fidelity PC\-based surgical training platform integrated with a robotic surgeon console.
 



 This is a physics\- and shader\-intensive simulation role, focused on interactive training and realistic simulation rather than visual\-only walkthroughs.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Unity Development \& Training Module Implementation** 




 • Develop interactive surgical training modules using Unity and C\#.
 



 • Implement instrument drills, procedural exercises, multi\-step surgical workflows, and training scenarios.
 



 • Develop modular and reusable gameplay/simulation systems using clean and maintainable architecture.
 



 • Implement training states, state machines, scoring systems, procedural progression, fail/retry flows, checkpoints, and completion logic.
 



 • Develop interactive systems for surgical instruments, anatomical structures, operating\-room environments, and robotic systems.
 



 • Ensure reliable behavior across different training scenarios and user interactions.
 



**2\. C\# Programming \& Simulation Architecture** 




 • Design, develop, and maintain robust C\# systems for the simulator.
 



 • Implement modular architectures using Prefabs, ScriptableObjects, interfaces, events, dependency patterns, or equivalent approaches.
 



 • Develop reusable components and systems that can support multiple surgical training modules.
 



 • Maintain clean, readable, testable, and scalable code.
 



 • Identify and resolve performance, memory, logic, and integration issues.
 



 • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decisions for the simulation platform.
 



**3\. Soft\-Body \& Deformable Tissue Simulation** 




 • Develop and maintain interactive soft\-body, deformable tissue, and anatomical interaction systems.
 



 • Implement the project\-selected approach for tissue deformation and physical interaction.
 



 • Develop realistic interaction between surgical instruments and deformable anatomical structures.
 



 • Configure and optimize Rigidbody, Joint, Collider, and physics\-based interaction systems where applicable.
 



 • Balance physical realism with real\-time performance requirements.
 



 • Evaluate trade\-offs between simulation accuracy, stability, CPU/GPU usage, and training responsiveness.
 



 • Work with Simulation Engineers and Technical Artists to improve deformable tissue behavior.
 



**4\. Physics \& Collision Systems** 




 • Implement physics\-driven interactions for surgical instruments, robotic components, anatomical structures, and simulation environments.
 



 • Configure Rigid body, joints, constraints, triggers, collision detection, and interaction systems.
 



 • Integrate optimized collision geometry generated by the 3D art pipeline.
 



 • Understand and work with UCX collision meshes and optimized physics geometry.
 



 • Validate collision behaviour and identify issues related to penetration, jitter, tunneling, unstable physics, or incorrect collision setup.
 



 • Optimize physics calculations for real\-time workstation performance.
 



**5\. Shader \& Technical Rendering Development** 




 • Develop and maintain custom HLSL shaders for tissue, fluid, anatomical, and other simulation\-specific visual effects.
 



 • Implement advanced Shader Graph workflows, including HLSL/custom function blocks where appropriate.
 



 • Develop shader systems for realistic visualization of soft tissues, fluids, transparency, subsurface\-like effects, and dynamic surface characteristics.
 



 • Implement vertex\-color\-driven shader logic and data pipelines.
 



 • Connect gameplay/simulation parameters to shader properties for dynamic visual feedback.
 



 • Collaborate with Look\-Dev and Technical Art teams to ensure shader behavior matches the required visual and simulation objectives.
 



 • Optimize shader complexity for target workstation GPU performance.
 



**6\. Surgical Instrument \& Console Integration** 




 • Integrate surgical instrument and robotic console data into Unity according to the system architecture.
 



 • Develop interfaces between simulation systems and external device inputs where required.
 



 • Support integration of instrument position, orientation, interaction state, button/input data, and other device parameters.
 



 • Work with hardware, embedded, and systems teams to ensure reliable communication between the robotic console and Unity simulation.
 



 • Implement appropriate asynchronous and non\-blocking approaches for external device communication.
 



 • Support UDP, serial, SDK, or other communication protocols where applicable.
 



**7\. Training Logic, Scoring \& Assessment** 




 • Develop training assessment systems based on defined surgical tasks and procedural requirements.
 



 • Implement scoring logic, task completion criteria, error detection, penalties, and performance indicators.
 



 • Develop multi\-step procedural workflows and guided training sequences.
 



 • Implement fail, retry, reset, checkpoint, and recovery mechanisms.
 



 • Capture relevant simulation events and performance data for training evaluation.
 



 • Work with Clinical SMEs to translate approved training requirements into reliable software behavior.
 



**8\. Unity Scene \& Asset Integration** 




 • Consume and integrate development\-ready Unity scenes produced by the Look\-Dev and Technical Art teams.
 



 • Integrate 3D models, prefabs, materials, shaders, animations, UI elements, collision assets, and other production assets.
 



 • Respect established asset standards including:
 


* Scale
* Orientation
* Pivot
* Prefab structure
* LOD/HLOD
* UCX collision
* Naming conventions
* Folder structures
* • Identify and communicate art\-engine integration issues to the relevant teams.
* • Ensure integrated assets function correctly within the simulation architecture.



**9\. Performance Profiling \& Optimization** 




 • Profile Unity applications using Unity Profiler and other appropriate diagnostic tools.
 



 • Analyze and optimize:
 


* CPU performance
* GPU performance
* Memory usage
* Physics performance
* Rendering performance
* Shader performance
* Garbage collection
* Draw calls
* • Identify the actual source of performance bottlenecks and provide actionable optimization reports.
* • Optimize the simulator for defined workstation GPU and CPU targets.
* • Perform profiling and optimization throughout development rather than only at final build stage.
* • Balance simulation fidelity, visual quality, responsiveness, and hardware performance.



**12\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 • Work closely with:
 


* Simulation Lead
* Senior Unity Developers
* Unity Developers
* Technical Artists
* Look\-Dev Artists
* 3D Modelers
* Sculpting Artists
* Texturing Artists
* Simulation Engineers
* Hardware / Embedded Engineers
* Clinical SMEs
* QA / Validation Teams



 • Participate in sprint planning, technical reviews, simulation reviews, and development meetings.
 



 • Translate clinical and simulation requirements into practical software solutions.
 



 • Communicate technical dependencies, blockers, risks, and performance issues proactively.
 



 • Collaborate with artists to ensure assets are technically suitable for simulation.
 



**Qualifications and Experience:** 




 • Diploma / Bachelor’s degree / equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, Computer Graphics, Animation Technology, or a related field.
 



 •
 **4–6 years of professional experience in Unity development using C\#.** 




 • Proven experience delivering production or commercially used interactive 3D applications.
 



 • Strong professional experience with Unity and C\#.
 



 • Demonstrated experience with physics\-based or deformable/soft\-body interactions.
 



 • Strong experience with HLSL/custom shader development or advanced Shader Graph with HLSL/custom function blocks.
 



 • Strong understanding of Unity Profiler and CPU/GPU/memory optimization.
 



 • Experience with Rigidbody, Joint, Collider, trigger, and physics systems.
 



 • Experience with modular Unity architecture using Prefabs, ScriptableObjects, or equivalent approaches.
 



 • Experience with Git / Git LFS.
 



 • Experience developing Windows standalone Unity applications.
 



 • Experience working within multidisciplinary game, simulation, XR, robotics, or real\-time 3D teams is preferred.
 



 • Experience in surgical simulation, medical visualization, robotics, serious games, or training simulators will be an added advantage.
 



**Skills and Competencies:** 




**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong proficiency in Unity and C\#.
 



 • Strong understanding of object\-oriented programming and software architecture.
 



 • Strong understanding of Unity physics systems.
 



 • Practical experience with soft\-body / deformable physics.
 



 • Strong knowledge of HLSL and custom shader development.
 



 • Advanced understanding of Shader Graph is an advantage.
 



 • Experience with vertex\-color\-driven shader workflows.
 



 • Strong understanding of Unity Profiler and performance optimization.
 



 • Good understanding of CPU, GPU, memory, rendering, and physics profiling.
 



 • Experience with collision meshes, including UCX workflows.
 



 • Experience with Prefabs, Scriptable Objects, scene management, and modular architectures.
 



 • Good understanding of asynchronous programming and non\-blocking external I/O.
 



 • Working knowledge of UDP, serial communication, SDK integration, or similar device interfaces is an advantage.
 



 • Strong understanding of Git / Git LFS.

**Location:** Ahmedabad / Field\-based (Local territory)

**Job Type:** Full\-time

**Department:** Sales \& Business Development

**Reports To:** Founder / Sales Manager

About Govalay Dairy \& Farm

At Govalay Dairy \& Farm, we are dedicated to delivering farm\-fresh, premium dairy products directly to our consumers and retail partners. Specializing in high\-purity items—including fresh milk, farm malai paneer, and traditional A2 cow bilona ghee—our mission is to provide unadulterated, wholesome nutrition while expanding our footprint across general trade, modern retail, and direct\-to\-consumer networks.

Role Overview

We are looking for an energetic, results\-driven **Sales Assistant cum Representative** to actively drive retail distribution, manage daily B2B and B2C sales operations, and build long\-term relationships with dairy counters, grocery stores, supermarkets, and institutional buyers (restaurants, cafes, caterers).

This hybrid role balances **field\-level sales execution** (onboarding retailers, taking daily orders, expanding shelf presence) with **operational sales support** (dispatch coordination, payment follow\-ups, and customer inquiries).

Key Responsibilities1\. Field Sales \& Market Expansion

* Identify, visit, and onboard new retail partners including standalone dairy outlets, local kirana stores, modern trade formats, and HoReCa (Hotels, Restaurants, Caterers) clients.
* Pitch the unique selling points (USPs) of Govalay products—emphasizing freshness, pure milk sourcing, and zero\-adulteration standards over analog alternatives.
* Secure optimal shelf placement, point\-of\-sale display positioning, and brand visibility in partner stores.
* Conduct regular market visits across assigned territories to gather retailer feedback and track competitor pricing/promotions.

2\. Account Management \& Daily Order Processing

* Manage regular reorder cycles for perishable and non\-perishable inventory (milk, fresh paneer, bilona ghee) to prevent stockouts while minimizing expired\-return losses.
* Coordinate closely with the farm and packaging/dispatch teams to ensure timely delivery schedules for morning and evening dispatch runs.
* Collect and log daily orders via mobile sales apps, WhatsApp Business, or daily route sheets.

3\. Sales Support \& Collections

* Monitor outstanding balances, reconcile billing discrepancies, and ensure timely payment collection from retail clients and distributors.
* Handle incoming customer and retailer inquiries, sample requests, and product quality concerns promptly and professionally.
* Assist in organizing weekend sampling drives, society pop\-ups, or local promotional activations.

4\. Reporting \& Targets

* Achieve agreed monthly and quarterly sales volume targets across key product lines.
* Maintain a daily sales log: store visits made, new leads converted, orders booked, and collection status.

**Vehicle \& License**Must own a two\-wheeler with a valid driving license for daily field visits.

**Languages**Fluent in Gujarati and Hindi; basic working English is a plus.

**Tech Skills**Familiarity with smartphone applications, WhatsApp Business, Google Sheets, and basic order\-entry tools.

Key Competencies

* **Persuasive Communication:** Ability to pitch product quality clearly to both shopkeepers and retail customers.
* **Integrity \& Punctuality:** Strong work ethic, especially regarding early morning retail supply schedules.
* **Negotiation \& Hustle:** Comfort with direct cold\-calling on retail stores and closing accounts independently.
* **Basic Numeracy:** Quick calculations for trade margins, bulk discounts, and invoice totals.

Compensation \& Benefits

description:
**Job Title: Jr. QC Executive – Quality Control**

**Department:** Quality Control  
**Designation:** Jr. QC Executive / QC Officer  
**Industry:** Cleaning \& Hygiene Products Manufacturing  
**Location:** Factory  
**Reporting To:** QC Executive / QC Manager / QA Manager

**Job Purpose**

To support the Quality Control team in ensuring that raw materials, packaging materials, in\-process products, and finished cleaning \& hygiene products meet defined quality standards and specifications before being released for production or dispatch.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Raw Material \& Packaging Material Testing**

* Inspect and test incoming raw materials as per approved specifications.
* Check chemicals, fragrances, colours, preservatives, surfactants and other ingredients.
* Verify packaging materials such as bottles, caps, labels, cartons and other components.
* Record inspection and test results accurately.
* Inform seniors about any non\-conforming material.

**2\. In\-Process Quality Control**

* Conduct regular quality checks during production.
* Check parameters such as **pH, viscosity, colour, appearance, odour, specific gravity and other product\-specific parameters**.
* Ensure batch samples are collected and tested as per SOP.
* Coordinate with Production for correction of deviations.

**3\. Finished Product Testing**

* Test finished products according to approved specifications and test methods.
* Ensure products meet quality requirements before release.
* Maintain proper records of test results and batch\-wise QC documentation.
* Escalate any deviation or non\-conformance to the senior QC/QA team.

**4\. Documentation**

* Maintain QC test reports, batch records, sampling records and inspection reports.
* Maintain laboratory registers and calibration records.
* Prepare and maintain COA\-related data as required.
* Ensure all QC documents are updated and properly filed.

**5\. Laboratory Activities**

* Handle laboratory equipment and testing instruments properly.
* Maintain cleanliness and 5S in the QC laboratory.
* Ensure proper storage and identification of chemicals and samples.
* Follow laboratory safety procedures and PPE requirements.

**6\. Quality \& Compliance**

* Follow company SOPs, GMP and quality standards.
* Support internal audits and customer/third\-party audits.
* Assist in investigation of customer complaints and quality issues.
* Support CAPA and corrective action activities wherever required.

**7\. Coordination**

* Coordinate with **Production, R\&D, Stores and QA** for quality\-related matters.
* Communicate quality deviations immediately to the reporting manager.
* Support production trials and new product development activities when required.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of **QC testing of liquid cleaning and hygiene products**.
* Knowledge of pH meter, weighing balance, viscosity measurement and other basic laboratory instruments.
* Basic knowledge of chemical handling and laboratory safety.
* Good observation and analytical skills.
* Good documentation and record\-keeping ability.
* Basic knowledge of **GMP, 5S, SOP and quality systems**.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and Word.

**Qualification**

* **B.Sc. Chemistry / M.Sc. Chemistry / B.Pharm / Diploma in Chemical Engineering** or relevant qualification.
* **0–2 years of experience** in QC, preferably in **cleaning chemicals, hygiene products, chemical or similar manufacturing industries**.
* Freshers with relevant knowledge may also be considered.

We specialize in the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of complete fire fighting systems, including Hydrants, Sprinklers, Pumping Stations, Drenchers, and related systems for commercial, industrial, and residential projects.

Job Purpose

The Assistant Purchase Executive will support the Purchase \& Procurement team in sourcing materials, coordinating with vendors, preparing purchase documentation, tracking orders and deliveries, and ensuring the timely availability of materials as per project requirements.

Key Responsibilities1\. Purchase \& Procurement

* Assist in identifying and sourcing materials as per project requirements.
* Collect quotations from existing and new suppliers.
* Compare quotations based on price, quality, specifications, delivery time, and payment terms.
* Assist in preparing Purchase Orders (POs) after receiving the required approvals.
* Follow up with vendors for order confirmation and timely delivery.
* Coordinate with internal departments regarding material requirements.

2\. Vendor Coordination

* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors regarding quotations, orders, deliveries, and other purchase\-related requirements.
* Maintain professional relationships with existing vendors.
* Assist in identifying potential new suppliers.
* Follow up with vendors regarding pending orders and delivery schedules.
* Escalate issues related to delayed deliveries, incorrect materials, quality concerns, or billing discrepancies to the reporting manager.

3\. Material \& Inventory Coordination

* Coordinate with the Store team to check material availability.
* Assist in monitoring stock levels and identifying material requirements.
* Maintain records related to inward and outward materials.
* Check received materials against Purchase Orders and delivery documents.
* Coordinate with the Store and Project teams regarding material requirements.

4\. Purchase Order \& Delivery Tracking

* Maintain records of Purchase Orders issued.
* Track pending and open Purchase Orders.
* Follow up with vendors for dispatch and delivery status.
* Update the reporting manager regarding pending or delayed materials.
* Coordinate with vendors and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery.

5\. Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain purchase\-related documents such as quotations, comparison statements, POs, invoices, delivery challans, and vendor details.
* Maintain and update purchase trackers in Excel.
* Assist in preparing purchase and pending\-order reports.
* Ensure proper filing and documentation of procurement transactions.

6\. Cost \& Quality Coordination

* Compare vendor quotations and assist in identifying cost\-effective options.
* Assist the reporting manager in vendor negotiations.
* Ensure that materials are procured as per approved specifications and requirements.
* Report discrepancies related to quantity, quality, specifications, or pricing.

7\. Internal Coordination

* Coordinate with Project, Site, Store, Accounts, and other departments regarding purchase requirements.
* Follow up on urgent material requirements.
* Ensure proper communication of material requirements and delivery updates.
* Perform other purchase\-related activities assigned by the reporting manager.

Candidate Requirement Educational Qualification

As a **UGC Content Creator**, you will be responsible for creating short\-form video content that promotes our brand, services, campaigns, and marketing initiatives.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable **facing the camera, speaking naturally, creating hooks, following trends, and converting marketing messages into engaging content**.

You will work closely with the marketing and creative teams to develop content concepts, scripts, reels, testimonials, product/service explainers, and promotional videos.

* Develop relatable and authentic content rather than overly promotional content.

* Talking\-head videos
* Explainer videos

* Problem\-solution videos
* Product/service demonstrations
* Educational content
* Trend\-based Reels
* Promotional videos
* FAQ videos
* Customer\-perspective videos

* Convert marketing briefs into simple, conversational language.
* Deliver dialogues naturally instead of sounding scripted.
* Experiment with different tones, storytelling styles, hooks, and CTAs.

Shooting \& Basic Production

* Record high\-quality videos using a smartphone or camera.
* Maintain good lighting, framing, audio, background, and overall presentation.
* Coordinate with the editing team or perform basic editing when required.

Social Media \& Trends

* Stay updated with current social\-media trends.
* Monitor competitor and industry content.
* Identify trending formats that can be adapted to the company's brand.
* Maintain awareness of what performs well on Reels and Shorts.
* Track content performance and use insights to improve future videos.

Collaboration

* Work with the marketing, performance marketing, design, and content teams.
* Participate in content planning and brainstorming sessions.
* Take feedback positively and make revisions when required.
* Maintain a consistent content schedule.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong confidence in front of the camera.
* Natural and expressive presentation style.
* Good understanding of Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.
* Ability to create strong hooks and CTAs.
* Good storytelling ability.
* Creativity and willingness to experiment.
* Basic understanding of social\-media trends.
* Ability to follow scripts while maintaining a natural delivery.
* Good sense of body language, expressions, and presentation.
* Basic knowledge of mobile video shooting and editing is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, Media, Advertising, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
* Previous experience creating Reels, Shorts, UGC, influencer content, or social\-media videos will be an advantage.
* Candidates with a strong personal Instagram/YouTube portfolio are encouraged to apply.

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who:

* **Loves being in front of the camera.**
* Can speak confidently and naturally.
* Understands what makes people stop scrolling.
* Is comfortable experimenting with different content styles.
* Can turn a simple idea into an engaging video.
* Is energetic, creative, and proactive.
* Can handle feedback and improve quickly.

depending on experience, communication skills, content\-creation ability, and overall fit.

title: User Interface Designer
description:
At CaratLane, design is how trust gets built. Someone deciding on a ₹80,000 solitaire on their phone needs the same confidence they'd feel holding it under a store light. Every pixel between them and that decision is either building that confidence or quietly eroding it.
 



 You'll own the visual and interaction layer of that journey \- across our website, our app, and the tools our store teams use every day. And you'll build the design system that lets the whole team move faster without the experience fragmenting.
 



**What you'll own** 




**Design system** 



* Build a scalable, component\-based design system from the ground up, or mature what exists, across web, Android, and iOS
* Define tokens, patterns, and documentation that let designers and engineers ship consistent UI faster
* Grow into governance \-what enters the system, how it's versioned, how adoption spreads across squads
* Partner with frontend and design engineering on the live component library (Storybook or equivalent)
* Understand each platform's paradigms rather than flattening them \- iOS, Android, desktop web, and tablet each have their own grammar



**Craft** 



* Become the leader of UI design for our highest\-traffic surfaces, and hold jewellery and luxury to the standard it deserves
* Generate pixel\-perfect production assets with obsessive attention to detail
* Set the visual and interaction quality bar, and raise the work around you through review
* Micro Motion where it earns its place \- micro\-interactions, transitions, and how the product feels in the hand



**Scale and leverage** 



* Use AI tools to scale design output: component variants, automated documentation, faster engineering handoff, less repetitive production work for the team
* Build AI\-assisted workflows the whole team can use, not just your own shortcuts
* Work with product and engineering to validate designs against real usage data and iterate after launch
* Collab with product designers on how ux journeys can be part of visually enriched flows, including how they build AI into their process
* Represent design in cross\-functional planning, and make the build\-vs\-reuse\-from\-system call



**How you'll work** 




 You'll work closely with almost everyone here \- product, tech, merchandising, retail, and the CXOs. That access is real, and it comes with an expectation: bring the thinking behind the work, document your decisions, and see a feature through from inception to live.
 



 You'll be expected to communicate proactively and persuasively \- verbally and in writing. Keeping stakeholders in the loop as your work progresses isn't a nice\-to\-have here; it's most of what separates designers who succeed at CaratLane from those who don't.
 



 Over time, you'll become one of the gatekeepers for experience quality before anything hits production.
 



**A few honest things about this role** 




 Most of what you design will not be trivial. You'll take a lot of feedback, explore a lot of dead ends, and iterate more than feels comfortable. You'll juggle several projects and help decide what gets dropped. The team is ego\-free and highly collaborative, and it only works if you are too.
 



**What you'll bring** 




**Must\-have** 



* A portfolio that shows meticulous visual craft \- spacing, type, hierarchy, restraint
* 2–3 years in UI design, including hands\-on work building or scaling a design system
* A strong instinct for colour, typography, and composition
* B2C or e\-commerce experience at meaningful scale \- high\-traffic, conversion\-driven surfaces
* Strong command of Figma: component architecture, variants, tokens, auto layout
* Practical use of AI tools (Figma AI, Claude, Midjourney, or similar) to speed up production, ideation, or documentation
* Proven consistency across web and native mobile
* Comfort with data \- funnel metrics, heatmaps, and A/B results as design inputs



**Good to have** 



* Fashion, luxury, lifestyle, or high\-consideration retail experience
* Figma Motion and animation skills are brownie points (After Effects, Rive, Framer, or similar)
* Illustration or bespoke iconography
* Omnichannel exposure, where the same customer moves between store and app
* Any experience mentoring designers, however informal



**Why us** 




 CaratLane serves customers across 400\+ stores and a digital business growing faster than ever. The system you build will touch every one of those journeys. Real traffic, real stakes, leadership visibility, and a category where beautiful work actually shows
 



 .While you're at it, we'll make sure you do some of the best work of your career

title: Content Writer
description:
2Base Technologies is building out its marketing function, and this role is the entry point into the content team.
 



 We are a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working as an enterprise solutions partner for clients across the United States, the United Kingdom and other global markets. Our work spans AI implementation, custom software development, legacy system modernisation and operational transformation.
 



 This is a writing role for someone at the start of their career who wants to become genuinely good at explaining technology in plain English. You will produce real published work from your first month, and you will be edited closely while you do it.
 



  





**What This Role Exists to Do** 




 The content team publishes to an audience of technical leaders and business decision\-makers: CTOs and IT Directors who evaluate architecture decisions, and Founders, COOs and Operations leaders who are accountable for technology outcomes without a technical background of their own.
 



 This role produces the first drafts that sit underneath that output. You take a written brief, do the reading, and deliver a draft that is clean, on topic, and written for the reader named in the brief. The brief comes to you. The voice is already defined. Your job is to write well inside both.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 



* First drafts of blog posts and long\-form articles, written from briefs set by the Content and Thought Leadership Specialist
* Client case studies and project write\-ups, working from delivery team inputs
* Social media copy for the 2Base company channels
* Website page copy and updates
* Research and source gathering behind longer pieces, including reading the technical material well enough to summarise it accurately
* Publishing and scheduling support once a piece has cleared the quality gate



  





**What You Will Not Own** 



* **The 2Base content voice:** 
 it is already defined and documented, and you write within it
* **Content briefs:** 
 the Content and Thought Leadership Specialist writes them, you write to them
* **SEO keyword selection:** 
 the Organic Growth and SEO Specialist sets this
* **Visual design of content assets:** 
 the Visual Designer owns this
* **Distribution and channel decisions:** 
 the Marketing and Growth Lead owns this
* **Final publishing approval:** 
 nothing goes live without passing the content quality gate



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Experience** 



* 0 to 2 years of writing experience. Fresh graduates are welcome and are a core part of the target profile.
* Any discipline. We do not require a journalism, English or communications degree.
* Evidence of writing, in whatever form you have it: an internship, freelance work, a campus publication, a personal blog, a newsletter, or a piece written for a university project.
* If you have no published work at all, the application instructions below tell you what to send instead.



**Writing Ability** 



* Writes clean, correct English. Grammar, punctuation and sentence construction are sound before an editor sees the work.
* Can write to a brief: hits the topic, the named reader and the length asked for, without being chased.
* Can explain something to a reader who does not already understand it, without either talking down to them or hiding behind jargon.
* Reads their own work back and fixes it before submitting.



**Mindset** 



* Genuinely interested in technology. You do not need to know how software is built. You do need to want to find out.
* Takes edits without taking them personally. This role is heavily edited by design for the first 90 days.
* Reliable on deadlines, and says so early when something will be late.
* Uses AI tools as a drafting aid and can say clearly where the tool stopped and their own thinking started.



**What We Are Not Looking For** 



* Writing that has been generated and lightly edited. We check for this, and it is the fastest route to a decline.
* Candidates who are interested in writing in the abstract but have no curiosity about the subject matter.
* Anyone who cannot accept a rewrite.
* Candidates looking for a short engagement to add a line to a CV. This role assumes you are here to learn the craft properly.



  





**An Honest Note on This Role** 




 This is an entry\-level role with real output. It is not a shadowing role and it is not an observation period. You will be given briefs and you will be expected to deliver against them.
 



 It is also closely supervised. The brief structure, the voice standard and the quality gate already exist, so you learn inside a working system rather than inventing one. Expect a great deal of editing in your first three months, and expect the reasoning behind each edit to be explained to you.
 



 If you want to be an accomplished technology writer in two years and you are willing to be edited hard to get there, this is a good place to start. If you want to publish your own work largely unchanged, it is not.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Send your CV and one writing sample to
 **careers@2basetechnologies.com** 
 with the subject line: Content Writer, followed by your name.
 



 If you have no published sample, send a 200 word piece instead, explaining one benefit of automated software testing to an operations head at a client company who does not write code.

 This is a hands\-on role with a
 **full\-stack / backend focus** 
 , where you will work with JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, REST APIs, databases, integrations, debugging, and existing codebases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to understand how different layers of a web application work together.
   

  

* Job Type: Internship

**What You Will Work With**

* Backend: Node.js, Express.js / NestJS
* APIs: REST APIs, HTTP methods, request/response lifecycle, middleware, authentication and authorization
* Databases: MongoDB and PostgreSQL
* ORM / Data Access: Prisma or similar tools
* Authentication: JWT, cookies, sessions, role\-based access
* Development: Git, GitHub, npm/yarn, environment configuration
* Integrations: Third\-party APIs, file uploads, email services, and external services


**What You Will Do**
* Build and maintain REST APIs using Node.js
* Develop frontend features using React / Next.js
* Connect frontend applications with backend APIs
* Implement authentication, authorization, validation, and error handling
* Work with databases and write efficient queries
* Debug and fix issues across frontend and backend
* Integrate third\-party APIs and services
* Work with existing codebases and understand their architecture
* Participate in code reviews and follow established coding practices
* Write reusable and maintainable components and services
* Test APIs and application functionality
* Work with Git and collaborate with the development team


**What We're Looking For**
* Strong fundamentals in JavaScript
* Working knowledge of Node.js and React.js
* Basic\-to\-good understanding of REST APIs
* Basic understanding of databases, including CRUD operations, relationships, and indexing
* Understanding of Node.js asynchronous programming, promises, async/await, and the event loop
* Understanding of routing, controllers, services, middleware, validation, and error handling
* Basic understanding of authentication and authorization
* Understanding of how frontend applications communicate with backend APIs
* Basic TypeScript knowledge and understanding of why it is used in larger applications
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub, including commits, branches, pull requests, and resolving conflicts
* Ability to read, understand, debug, and modify existing code
* Ability to use logs, browser developer tools, and API testing tools such as Postman
* Strong problem\-solving skills and willingness to learn


**Good to Have**
 Experience with any of the following will be an advantage:
   

  

* Next.js or NestJS
* Prisma
* MongoDB aggregation and indexes
* PostgreSQL
* JWT authentication and role\-based access control
* Redis / caching
* Background jobs or queues
* WebSockets / Socket.IO
* Docker
* Basic cloud or deployment knowledge
* Third\-party API integrations
* File storage and upload systems
* GitHub Actions or basic CI/CD concepts

 We are not looking for someone who only knows how to follow tutorials or YouTube projects. You should be able to explain the fundamentals behind what you build.
   

  

 You should have a basic understanding of questions such as:
   

  

* What happens when a request reaches a Node.js server?
* How does Express middleware work?
* How does a React application communicate with an API?
* What happens between a frontend button click and a database update?
* What is the difference between authentication and authorization?
* Why do we use controllers, services, and modules in a backend?
* How does asynchronous code work in Node.js?
* What happens when an API returns an error?
* How would you structure a small backend application?
* How do databases and indexes affect API performance?


 You don't need to know everything.
 **Strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to understand an existing codebase are more important than knowing a long list of technologies.**

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Embedded Firmware Engineer to join our engineering team in Bangalore. In this Software Engineer role, you will contribute across the aerospace software development lifecycle, including requirements\-based design, implementation, verification, and certification support in accordance with DO\-178B/C and applicable project standards.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work as an independent contributor in a collaborative, fast\-paced environment. Clear written and verbal communication is essential for reporting status, delivering milestones, and working effectively with engineering teams, customers, managers, and certification stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, debug, troubleshoot, and maintain embedded application software, device drivers, and operating system firmware using C and/or C\+\+.
* Develop scalable, portable, and efficient software architectures and detailed designs that satisfy defined requirements.
* Collaborate with hardware and systems engineers to understand system requirements and review schematics, datasheets, and interface specifications.
* Perform requirements\-based high\-level and low\-level software verification to demonstrate that the implemented software satisfies its corresponding requirements.
* Create and review lifecycle data, including requirements, design documentation, source code, tests in accordance project standards.
* Participate in customer and certification\-authority audits and clearly explain the technical aspects of the software, its verification evidence, and associated lifecycle data.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, with at least two years of relevant experience.
* Strong embedded C programming skills, including knowledge of data structures, memory management, and low\-level programming.
* Experience developing and executing test cases for high\-level and low\-level software testing using tools such as IBM Rational Test RealTime, VectorCAST, or equivalent tools.
* Sound understanding of embedded systems fundamentals, including microcontroller architecture, interrupts, memory, timing, and real\-time behavior.
* Hands\-on experience with processors or microcontrollers from Microchip, STMicroelectronics, Texas Instruments, or similar providers.
* Experience with embedded development environments such as IAR Embedded Workbench, MPLAB X IDE, Keil, or equivalent tools.
* Experience developing device drivers or software interfaces for peripherals and communication protocols such as ARINC 429, I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, ADC, and DAC.
* Ability to read and interpret datasheets, electrical schematics, interface control information, and other hardware documentation.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Practical experience with aerospace software development and verification activities performed in accordance with DO\-178B/C.
* Working knowledge of IBM Engineering Requirements Management DOORS for requirements management, Mantis for issue tracking, and PVCS for configuration management, or equivalent tools.
* Ability and willingness to use approved AI\-assisted tools responsibly to improve productivity, decision\-making, work quality, and cost effectiveness.
* Familiarity with full\-lifecycle aerospace engineering projects, including development, verification, configuration management, quality assurance, and certification support.
* Working knowledge of C\+\+ and Python.
* Exposure to test software development using LabVIEW, Microsoft Visual Studio, and C\#.


**Core Competencies**
* Strong learning agility and willingness to adapt to new technologies, tools, and project needs.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with strong technical documentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and within a multidisciplinary team.
* Attention to detail, disciplined problem solving, and commitment to quality and compliance.

 , with exposure to both generalist and strategic responsibilities

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**HR Manager** 




 StrainX Bioworks · Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh · On\-site · Full\-time
 



  





**About us** 




 StrainX Bioworks is a deep tech company building biology at industrial scale. We design microbes that produce proteins that today come from animals and plants, and we manufacture them ourselves at our plant near Bhopal. We have more than 100 people, a plant that is already running, and customers trialing the product.
 



  





 Our factory is at Tamot near Bhopal. Our research center is in Bengaluru. Our corporate office is in Bhopal.
 



  





 We spent three years building quietly before we said anything publicly. Today we are more than 100 people; we are venture\-backed, our plant is running, and customers are trialing our product. This is a real company with real operations, not a startup that is just getting started.
 



  





**The role** 




 We are looking for an HR professional to own the HR function. Not to assist it. To own it.
 



 You will be the person the whole company goes to for anything people\-related, across three very different environments: a manufacturing plant, a research lab, and a corporate office. Each has its own rhythm, compliance requirements, and kind of employee. That variety is the job.
 



  





 You will report to leadership and work directly with department heads. No layer sits between you and the decisions.
 



  





**What you will own** 




 • Day\-to\-day HR operations for the whole company, run independently.
 



 • Recruitment coordination: hiring plans with department heads, interview scheduling, candidate communication, offers, and closing.
 



 • Onboarding, employee documentation, and the full employee file from joining to exit.
 



 • Attendance, leave, payroll inputs, HR records, and statutory compliance.
 



 • Clear HR trackers, processes, deadlines, and reporting that hold up without anyone chasing you for them.
 



 • Employee communication, day\-to\-day issue resolution, and putting policy into practice.
 



 • Improving the HR function as the company grows, including the systems it runs on.
 



  





**What we are looking for** 




 • 7 to 10 years of end\-to\-end HR experience. Core HR, not only recruitment and not only administration.
 



 • Someone who takes ownership and makes things happen without being followed up with.
 



 • Organized and proactive. You build the tracker before someone asks for it.
 



 • Confident and firm when a situation calls for it, and calm while doing it.
 



 • Strong communication and the ability to hold your ground with department heads.
 



 • Based in Bhopal, or ready to relocate and work full\-time from Bhopal.
 



  





**Why this one is worth a look** 




 Most HR roles at this level are about running a function someone else designed. This one is about building it. You will decide how hiring works here, what our policies actually say, how we keep records, and what good looks like. What you build is what the next 300 people will join into.
 



  





 You will also get a range that is hard to find in one job. Plant, lab, and office in the same week. Blue\-collar and PhD in the same headcount plan.
 



  





 And it is in Bhopal. If you are from here, or you left and have been looking for a reason to come back to work that is genuinely ambitious, this is one.
 



  





**To apply** 




 Apply through LinkedIn or email your CV/Resume to careers@strainx.in.

 Development plans for high\-potential and critical talent

 Managers enabled to conduct effective goal\-setting and

 management

description:
About the Organization
   





 Swaniti Initiative is a social enterprise that is working at the intersection of climate, governance and last mile delivery. We believe that while the willingness and resources exist, there are fundamental gaps in the execution within communities that is the biggest crisis in the climate movement. Accordingly, Swaniti works with subnational governments to conduct microplanning exercises with consultations with community and key stakeholders to understand the pathways forward, provide technical assistance to subnational governments to provide support in program implementation and support in monitoring and delivery of programs.
   





 Swaniti has been working across multiple geographies in the global south to unlock capital. Our three core metrics include unlocking public capital, ensuring last mile communities are directly benefitted and creating systemic changes in the public service systems. While we are continuing to focus on impact, it is critical to have a lead who has a deep understanding about monitoring, evaluation and learning. Our intention is to create an institutional capabilities to measure and document the scale of our impact and look at how learning can be replicated across the institution.
   




 Swaniti Initiative is seeking a dynamic and passionate individual to join our People's Team as an Associate. As an Associate on the People's Team, you will play a crucial role in supporting the organization's human resources and talent management functions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to our mission\-driven work and make a meaningful impact on the lives of individuals and communities.

* Assist in the development and coordination of programs and activities that promote a positive and engaging work environment.
* Serve as a resource for employees, helping to address their questions and concerns in a supportive and compassionate manner.



 3\. Learning and Development:
   




* Collaborate on training programs and opportunities that help our employees grow in their roles and deepen their impact on our mission.
* Help in tracking and reporting on training and development initiatives.



 4\. HR Data and Reporting:
   




* Maintain HR databases and generate reports that provide insights for our organization's decision\-making.
* Ensure our HR practices align with our mission and values.



 5\. Miscellaneous:
   




* HR support as and when needed



  

  

  

  




 Requirements
   

  


 Qualifications Required
   




* Master's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2\-3 years of experience in human resources, talent management.
* Knowledge of HR principles, practices, and regulations.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications and HRIS software, preferably ZOHO.
* Commitment to Swaniti's mission and values.



 In case you do not hear from us within 30 days, please consider your application to be unsuccessful and your application has been retained in our database for future opportunities.
