title: Transformation Officer
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different in what we do, how we work, and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

 The Transformation Officer is an intellectually curious, analytically driven role at the foundation of the Transformation Office. Working as a core member of a transformation program team, this individual supports the delivery of discrete workstreams by conducting structured business analysis, gathering and synthesising operational data, mapping processes, engaging with subject matter experts, and producing clear outputs that drive informed decision\-making and program progress.
   

  

 This is an ideal role for an early\-career professional with the mindset of a consultant — someone who is energised by problem\-solving, takes initiative to dig into the detail, and takes pride in producing high\-quality, rigorous work. The Transformation Officer will work closely alongside global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business, gaining broad exposure to the firm's operations and technology landscape while contributing meaningfully to real transformation outcomes from day one.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Analysis \& Research**
* Conduct structured current\-state analysis to understand existing processes, workflows, roles, and operational pain points, through interviews, workshops, and data review
* Gather, clean, and analyse quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement
* Develop and maintain process maps, data models, and analytical frameworks that underpin workstream findings and recommendations
* Analyse interdependencies between people, process, technology, and governance elements of the operating model, under the guidance of the Senior Officer or Program Lead
* Proactively research best practices, benchmarks, and comparable approaches to inform solution design
* Contribute to the development of business cases, options papers, and other analytical outputs that inform senior decision\-making


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Requirements Gathering**
* Engage day\-to\-day with global process owners, operations teams, and lines of business to gather information, validate analysis, and support the change process
* Support the facilitation of workshops and interviews with stakeholders across functions to capture requirements, surface pain points, and gather input
* Assist in translating business needs into clear, structured requirements and user stories for technology and process workstreams
* Support change impact assessments and stakeholder mapping activities
* Build constructive working relationships with subject matter experts and operational counterparts across the business
* Communicate findings and workstream updates clearly and concisely, both verbally and in writing, in a manner appropriate to the audience


**Technology\-Enabled Transformation**
* Support work with Global Process Owners, Tech, Product, and Operations teams to understand technology solutions and their implications for the operating model
* Contribute to the definition of functional requirements and business logic for tech\-enabled tools, workflows, and automation opportunities
* Develop an active awareness of AI and agentic AI tools and their potential to create value within transformation workstreams, in line with Alter Domus's AI governance framework
* Assist in ensuring alignment between business processes and system capabilities, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for resolution


**Workstream Support \& Delivery**
* Support the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned workstreams, taking ownership of defined tasks and deliverables within the broader program plan
* Maintain up\-to\-date workstream documentation, including process maps, trackers, issue logs, and meeting notes
* Assist with data analysis, reporting, and insights to inform program governance and decision\-making
* Participate in testing, user acceptance, and validation activities to ensure solutions meet business needs
* Identify and escalate risks, blockers, and dependencies promptly, with an initial view on potential solutions
* Demonstrate a self\-starter attitude — proactively progressing work without waiting for direction, and consistently delivering to a high standard


**Change Management \& Documentation**
* Support the design and delivery of change activities, including communications, training materials, and readiness assessments
* Help identify change resistance and contribute to strategies that build engagement and adoption across impacted teams
* Produce clear, well\-structured documentation of current\-state and future\-state processes, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and knowledge assets to enable smooth transition to new ways of working
* Contribute to knowledge transfer activities and ensure workstream outputs are thoroughly recorded and accessible for BAU teams


**Essential**
**Skills \& Experience Required:**
* 3\-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, business analysis, operations, financial services, or a related analytical field; exceptional recent graduates will also be considered
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills — able to structure problems clearly, analyse data rigorously, and draw well\-reasoned conclusions
* High attention to detail with a commitment to producing accurate, high\-quality work
* Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information in a structured and compelling way
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; ability to build clean models and well\-structured presentations
* A proactive, self\-starting mindset — intellectually curious, eager to learn, and comfortable taking initiative in ambiguous situations
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment
* High levels of personal drive, ownership, and accountability


**Desirable** 
  

  

* Domain knowledge in one or more of the following:
+ Fund Administration (e.g., NAV production, investor reporting, transfer agency, custody operations, or related middle/back\-office processes)
+ Financial Services Technology (e.g., platforms, infrastructure, system implementations, or digital transformation)
+ AI Enablement (e.g., GenAI adoption, process automation, AI\-assisted workflows, or data\-driven transformation)

* Sound understanding of how regulated financial services entities operate, with some exposure to fund administration, private equity, alternative investments, or wealth management
* Exposure to regulatory change programmes or compliance\-driven transformation
* Experience with service design, customer journey mapping, or lean/six sigma methodologies
* Prior exposure to process improvement, project delivery, or transformation activity in any context (professional or academic)
* Familiarity with process mapping or collaboration tools (e.g., Visio, Lucidchart, Miro, Confluence, Jira)
* Familiarity with project management or change management frameworks (e.g., Agile, PRINCE2, Prosci, Kotter)
* Familiarity with technology concepts such as workflow automation, system integration, APIs, and cloud\-based platforms
* Business analysis certification (e.g., BCS, IIBA/CBAP) or Agile/Scrum certification (CSM, CSPO) a plus
* Undergraduate or postgraduate degree from a leading institution, ideally in Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a field with role\-relevant transferable skills


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)
   

  

 For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

description:
Founder's Office – Strategy \& Business Operations
 



**Location:** 
 Noida, Sector 62
 



**Experience:** 
 0–6 Years
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work From Office
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Reporting To:** 
 Founder / Leadership Team
 



  





**About CodeVyasa** 




 CodeVyasa is an
 **Applied AI \& Engineering Partner** 
 helping organizations build, scale, and transform their technology capabilities.
 



 With a growing team of 700\+ professionals, we work across
 **Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud, DevOps/SRE, Generative AI, Agentic AI and Software Engineering** 
 to solve complex technology and business challenges for our clients.
 



 As we continue to scale, we are looking for a high\-potential professional to join our
 **Founder’s Office** 
 and work closely with the founding team on business\-critical initiatives.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 As part of the Founder’s Office, you will work closely with the Founder and leadership team on initiatives that span
 **business strategy, growth, client initiatives, operations, research and special projects.** 




 You will be expected to take ownership of key initiatives, bring structure to complex problems, coordinate with stakeholders, and drive projects from
 **idea to execution** 
 .
 



 This role offers a
 **front\-row view of how a technology company is built and scaled** 
 , with exposure to decisions involving business, technology, clients, people and growth.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




 1\. Strategy \& Business Initiatives
 


* Work closely with the Founder and leadership team on strategic and business\-critical initiatives.
* Break down ambiguous business problems into structured plans, actionable insights and clear next steps.
* Conduct market, industry and competitor research to support business decisions.
* Identify opportunities for growth, operational improvement and expansion.
* Prepare business reviews, presentations, analysis and leadership\-ready documents.



 2\. Cross\-Functional Execution
 


* Take ownership of high\-priority projects from
 **problem identification to execution and closure** 
 .
* Work with teams across Sales, HR, Technology, Finance, Operations and Delivery to drive initiatives.
* Track priorities, timelines, dependencies and outcomes.
* Follow up with stakeholders and ensure important initiatives stay on track.
* Identify bottlenecks, escalate critical issues and help drive solutions.



 3\. Business Growth \& Client Initiatives
 


* Support the Founder and leadership team on strategic client and business development initiatives.
* Assist in preparing proposals, presentations, business cases and client\-facing material.
* Research prospective markets, companies, industries and business opportunities.
* Support initiatives around partnerships, new accounts and expansion opportunities.
* Participate in selected leadership/client discussions and translate insights into actionable outcomes.



 4\. Research, Analysis \& Decision Support
 


* Conduct structured research on technology, AI, industry trends, competitors and emerging business opportunities.
* Analyse business data and convert it into meaningful insights.
* Build dashboards, trackers and reports to monitor key initiatives and business metrics.
* Prepare concise summaries and insights for leadership discussions.



 5\. Special Projects
 


* Work on high\-impact projects directly assigned by the Founder/leadership team.
* Projects may span
 **AI, technology, sales, business operations, client strategy, organization building, market expansion and process improvement.**
* Take ownership of projects where there may not be a predefined playbook — and build one.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve research, analysis, productivity and execution.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 We are looking for someone who is
 **curious, sharp, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.** 




  





**You could be a strong fit if you:** 



* Have
 **0–6 years of experience** 
 in consulting, strategy, business operations, startups, business development, technology, project management or a similar high\-ownership environment.
* Have strong
 **analytical and problem\-solving abilities** 
 .
* Communicate clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing.
* Are comfortable working with senior leadership and multiple stakeholders.
* Can structure an ambiguous problem and independently figure out the next steps.
* Have strong execution and follow\-up skills.
* Are comfortable working with
 **Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides and modern AI tools** 
 .
* Learn quickly and are genuinely curious about
 **technology, AI and businesses** 
 .
* Can move between strategy and execution without needing a narrowly defined job description.
* Take ownership of outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks.



  





**Educational Background** 




 Candidates from backgrounds such as
 **Engineering, Economics, Business, Management, Commerce, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, MBA or other relevant disciplines** 
 are welcome.
 



 What matters more than the degree is your
 **ability to think, communicate, learn and execute.** 




  





**The Ideal Candidate** 




 You might be someone who:
 



**Sees a problem → understands it → structures it → finds the right people/data → builds a solution → drives execution → measures the outcome.** 




  





 If you enjoy figuring things out and taking ownership, you will thrive in this role.
 



  





**Why Join the Founder’s Office at CodeVyasa?** 



* **Work directly with the Founder \& leadership team**
* Get exposure to
 **real business decisions** 
 across functions
* Work across
 **AI, technology, sales, clients, strategy and operations**
* Own projects that have
 **visible business impact**
* Learn how a technology company scales from the inside
* Work with multiple teams and senior stakeholders
* Build strong skills in
 **strategy, business, execution and leadership**
* Opportunity to grow into roles across
 **Strategy, Business Operations, Growth, Chief of Staff, Business Leadership or other core functions** 
 based on performance and interests



  





 One Important Thing
 



 This role is for people who are comfortable with
 **ambiguity, fast execution and ownership.** 




 There will not always be a predefined playbook.
 



 Sometimes you will be given a problem instead of a task — and your job will be to figure out what needs to happen next.
 



**If that excites you, we'd love to hear from you.** 




  





**Apply for the Founder’s Office at CodeVyasa and work at the intersection of Technology, AI, Business and Leadership.**

title: OLIVER WYMAN - CORE CONSULTING GROUP - CONSULTANT - ISB
description:
**Who We Are**
 Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.
   

  

 We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.
   

  

 At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* As a member of your project team you’ll work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients worldwide to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.
* You’ll help teams understand client challenges by conducting research, gathering data, running surveys and interviews, and turning information into clear insights.
* You’ll analyze problems, identify patterns, test hypotheses, and help structure recommendations that support client decision\-making.
* You’ll contribute to client\-ready deliverables, including presentations, analysis, workshops, and discussions that help move projects forward.
* You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.
* You’ll likely have the chance to travel within your home market and internationally. No two weeks are ever the same.
* You’ll build core consulting skills from the start, including how to structure your work, communicate clearly, contribute to team problem\-solving, and manage your priorities.


**Why join us?**
 You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.
   

  

**Create solutions that have impact**
* Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.
* Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.
* Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.


**Develop as a leader**
* From day one, be encouraged to take initiative, ask questions, and bring your perspective to the work.
* Learn how to structure problems, communicate clearly, and contribute to team discussions and client conversations.
* As you grow, you’ll have opportunities to build confidence, take on more responsibility, and develop the skills to unlock the potential of others.


**Learn and grow without limits**
* Learn on the job and through formal training, developing core skills in communication, presentation, analytics, problem\-solving, and client management.
* Each project will give you new opportunities to learn from specialists, broaden your perspective, and build momentum in your career.
* You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.


**Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture**
* Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.
* Be part of an open, inclusive, and down\-to\-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.
* Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.


**Experience Rewards That Work For You**
* We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.
* Over time, you’ll have access to opportunities, programs, and experiences designed to help you perform, grow, and thrive — including non\-profit fellowships, sabbaticals, and externships.
* Enjoy competitive local benefits designed to support your well\-being, development, and life outside of work.


**Skills Required**
* People who display initiative, intuition, and creativity with a strong problem solving and analytical mindset.
* We do not require specific academic majors or industry experience and look for diversity of experience and skills.
* We value extracurricular activities and evidence of leading an interesting and impactful life outside of your studies.


 Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit oliverwyman.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

description:

 We are looking for an enthusiastic entry\-level Data Engineer with a growing DevOps mindset to help build and maintain reliable, scalable data pipelines that power business functions across the enterprise. This is a great opportunity for an early\-career engineer to learn, grow, and build hands\-on expertise — you'll support the team in developing data pipelines, learn CI/CD and operational practices, and take on increasing responsibility under the guidance of senior engineers.

 Databricks

* SQL

* Help build and maintain data pipelines on Databricks under guidance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Any Databricks or cloud certification is a plus.


**Competencies**
* Eagerness to learn and grow data engineering skills.
* Ownership mindset — takes pride in the quality of assigned work.
* Problem\-solving orientation — curiosity and attention to detail.
* Collaboration — works well with peers and mentors across teams.
* Clear communication — able to explain technical details to peers.

title: Quant Data Engineer
description:
**About BestEx Research:**
 BestEx Research is a U.S.\-based financial technology and research firm headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, with offices in the United Kingdom, India and Armenia. The firm specializes in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides its services to performance\-demanding hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker\-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model.
   

  

 BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients.
   

  

 Its cloud\-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end\-to\-end algorithmic trading solution for equities, futures, and foreign exchange that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algo customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre\-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for US equity and global futures trading.
   

  

 BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black\-box solutions from banks and offering next\-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading\-edge technology to support its low\-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems with its back end in C\+\+, research libraries in C\+\+/Python and R, and web\-based technologies for delivering its front\-end platforms.
   

  

 Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center." It's a core engineering and research hub \- working on the exact same problems and projects as our U.S. team. You'll be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science.
   

  

**What You'll Love:**
* Zero bureaucracy, zero silos—engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the CEO
* Direct ownership and end\-to\-end visibility on production systems
* Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low\-latency systems, and algo trading
* A high\-trust environment where performance speaks louder than hierarchy
* Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses


**Location: Bengaluru, India**
 Our beautiful Bengaluru office is conveniently located in Prestige Tech Park, Outer Ring Road, Marathahalli Road, Bangalore. Amenities include modern work spaces, free parking, recreational games, and free meals.
   

  

**Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch**
 As a Quantitative Data Engineer, you will be a key contributor to the team responsible for our core data ecosystem. You will work alongside experienced practitioners to build robust data pipelines, design efficient database schemas, and maintain the mission\-critical infrastructure that handles tick\-by\-tick market data and execution logs. This is an opportunity to contribute to scalable, performance\-optimized systems within the high\-stakes environment of algorithmic trading.
   

  

 At BestEx Research, our data engineers are deeply integrated into the research lifecycle. You will have the chance to develop a specialized understanding of global market microstructure, algorithmic execution, and performance measurement. At BestEx Research, data engineers are nested within a talented team of experts and practitioners in the field and may participate in writing research papers and interface closely with client research teams to improve trading costs. Your day to day responsibilities in this role can include, but are not limited to:
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Design, build, and optimize high\-throughput data pipelines using Python, R, and PostgreSQL to handle market and execution data
* Build and manage robust, scheduled data workflows using tools like Airflow/Dagster to ensure 24/7 data availability for global markets
* Monitor pipeline health, debug data discrepancies in logs, and implement automated data\-quality checks
* Build and maintain REST API\-based applications to serve analytics and performance metrics to both internal trading systems and external client interfaces
* Partner with Senior Quants and Product Managers to translate complex TCA research into production\-grade features and custom client analyses


**Requirements**
* Experience: 1 \- 4 Years
* A highly motivated self\-starter mindset with the ability to take end\-to\-end ownership of data products
* BTech/MTech in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related quantitative field
* Expert in Python (Numpy, Pandas, Polars, Multiprocessing etc) and advanced PostgreSQL (complex joins, window functions, and query optimization)
* Hands\-on experience building and orchestrating pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect)
* Strong foundation in applied statistics. Ability to form hypotheses, analyze idiosyncratic order flow, and validate results with statistical significance
* Ability to translate complex technical or statistical findings into clear insights for Senior Quants and clients
* Strong analytical problem\-solving skills
* Good Communication Skills


**Bonus Points For:**
* Experience building REST APIs (FastAPI, Django) to serve data at scale
* Exposure to C\+\+ or low\-latency environment concepts
* Familiarity with R for research and visualization
* Prior experience in fintech, electronic trading, or a data\-heavy research environment is highly valued
* Exposure to ML
* Exposure to AI is a big plus


**Benefits**
**Why This Role Is Rare**
* Exposure to real\-time trading systems live in global markets
* Direct mentorship from senior algorithmic trading and software engineering veterans
* Blend of research, systems design, and algorithm development
* Zero red tape, no outsourcing mentality

 Want to be part of the AI revolution and transform how the world’s largest global brands do business? Join us!
   

  

 Netomi is seeking a highly analytical and detail\-oriented candidate to join the Analytics team in Gurugram. As part of the team, you will work with data science, product, engineering, and customer success teams to drive complex data and trend analyses to propose ways to improve and thereby contribute to improving the experience. You will also be responsible for benchmarking and measuring the performance of various product operations projects, building and publishing detailed scorecards and reports, identifying and driving new opportunities based on customer and business data.
   

  

 We are looking for an Engineer with a passion for using data to discover and solve real\-world problems. You will enjoy working with rich data sets, modern business intelligence technology, and the ability to see your insights drive the features for our customers. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the development of policies, processes, and tools to address product quality challenges in collaboration with teams.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Architect and implement scalable, secure, and reliable data pipelines using modern data platforms (e.g., Spark, Databricks, Airflow, Snowflake, etc.).
* Develop ETL/ELT processes to ingest data from various structured and unstructured sources.
* Perform Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to uncover trends, validate data integrity, and derive insights that inform data product development and business decisions.
* Collaborate closely with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to design data models that support high\-quality analytics and real\-time insights.
* Write clean, maintainable code with comprehensive unit and integration tests to ensure reliability and stability in Python.
* Thrive in an agile, collaborative environment and take ownership of end\-to\-end feature delivery.


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in data engineering or backend software development roles.
* Solid understanding of Relational Databases (RDS, MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Experience with Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ for building asynchronous, decoupled systems.
* Proficiency with Python, SQL, and at least one data pipeline orchestration tool (e.g., Apache Airflow, Luigi, Prefect).
* Strong experience with cloud\-based data platforms (e.g., AWS Redshift, GCP BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks).
* Deep understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed systems.


**Additional Skills**
* Familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, containerization with Docker/Kubernetes).
* Exposure to AI/ML\-integrated solutions or interest in working alongside data science teams.
* Knowledge of data security and privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and how LLM\-based systems interact with data.


 Netomi is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: ETL Tester
description:
Medpace is growing rapidly, and we are currently seeking a full\-time, office\-based Software QA Test Engineer (Validation Engineer) to join our growing Information Technology (IT) team in Mumbai office.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, test scenarios, and test cases for ETL pipelines, backend database changes, data warehouse objects, and reporting solutions.
* Perform end\-to\-end ETL testing by validating source\-to\-target data across different stages of the data pipeline to ensure data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
* Develop and execute complex SQL and Snowflake queries to perform data validation, reconciliation, data profiling, and root\-cause analysis of data discrepancies.
* Validate database changes, including schemas, tables, views, stored procedures, indexes, and other database objects, for functional correctness and potential performance impact.
* Validate data warehouse dimensional models, including fact tables, dimension tables, and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD), against business and technical requirements.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, and data integrity testing following ETL code changes, source\-system updates, database changes, or schema modifications.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using a bug\-tracking system, working closely with developers and data engineers to investigate issues, validate fixes, and perform retesting.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers, BI Developers, Business Analysts, and other stakeholders to define acceptance criteria, testing requirements, and quality standards for new data pipelines, data models, and reports.
* Develop and maintain reusable SQL queries, test scripts, test data sets, reconciliation checks, and automated data validation frameworks to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and repeatability.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum bachelor’s degree, preferably in computer science background or related background
* 1\-2 years of experience in ETL, data warehouse or data migration testing;
* Strong understanding of software testing fundamentals and the testing lifecycle;
* Experience in design and executing SQL queries for database/backend validation using database tools like Casandra/ MSSQL/ Mongo DB/Studio 3T;
* Experience communicating and working within cross\-departmental teams consisting of software developers, department leads, and end users;
* Excellent computer, analytical, written and oral communication skills; and
* Experience in the regulated healthcare industry is a plus.


**Medpace Overview**
 Medpace is a full\-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l\-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in\-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti\-viral and anti\-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40\+ countries.
   

  

**Why Medpace?**
 When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting\-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross\-functional collaboration.
   

  

***Purpose\-Driven Work***
* 
+ Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry\-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence


***Collaborative Culture***
* 
+ Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
+ Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable


***Continuous Growth \& Development***
* 
+ Office based environment with on\-site mentors
+ Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
+ Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
+ Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
+ An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly


**Other Employee Benefits**
* 
+ Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
+ Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
+ Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
+ Company\-sponsored social events


*Please note benefits may vary based on country.*

 A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Company Profile
   

  

 Webbtree makes software to help companies find and hire great people. We get recruiting and its role in building healthy workplaces. And while we take recruiting seriously, we don't take ourselves too seriously.
   

  

 At Webbtree, you'll find smart people who have fun, learn and innovate, and help others do the same.
   

  

 We brainstorm, we laugh, and, occasionally, we party (there's a lot to celebrate), but we also appreciate people's need for quiet time and focused work.
   

  

 We respect everyone, we hire the best, and make sure every experience is special.
   

  

 If that’s not enough to join, we’re backed by a multi\-national Executive Search firm \- WhiteCrow Research that has been working with Global Fortune 100 companies for more than 12 years.
   

  

 DATA \& AI ENGINEER
   

  

**Mumbai, India \| Hybrid \| Full\-time \| 2\+ years**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a hands\-on Data \& AI Engineer to work on the data, search, analytics and AI systems powering our recruitment platform. This is not a traditional data analyst/reporting role. You will work across large\-scale search, data engineering, analytics, NLP and Generative AI, including OpenSearch, vector search, embeddings, reranking, LLMs and AI\-driven retrieval/screening systems.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Design, build and optimise large\-scale search/retrieval pipelines using OpenSearch / Elasticsearch.
* Work with keyword, vector, semantic and hybrid search; embeddings, ranking, relevance and filtering.
* Design scalable MySQL data models, schemas, indexes and queries; optimise database performance.
* Build ingestion, transformation, indexing/re\-indexing and data pipelines supporting AI, analytics and reporting.
* Build BI\-ready datasets and Tableau dashboards; ensure data quality and consistency.
* Experiment with and evaluate embeddings, rerankers, LLMs and ML models using accuracy, relevance, latency and cost.
* Build LLM/GenAI workflows using LangChain and Langfuse; support tracing, observability and evaluation.
* Take AI/data experiments from POC → production with backend and product teams; optimise latency, throughput, reliability and cost.
* Work with AWS infrastructure including OpenSearch, S3, EC2 and RDS.


 MUST HAVE
   

  

* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, ML/AI/GenAI, Search/Information Retrieval or Data Engineering.
* Strong Python programming and extremely strong SQL skills.
* Production experience with MySQL: schema design, query optimisation, indexing and performance tuning.
* Strong data modelling/database design and experience with large\-scale data pipelines/datasets.
* Practical ML/AI model evaluation experience and understanding of experimentation metrics.
* Experience with at least one of: LLMs, NLP, Generative AI, embedding models, reranking models or recommendation/search systems.
* Experience integrating external ML/AI models through APIs.


 GOOD TO HAVE
   

  

* Tableau/BI, data warehouses or analytics layers; Langfuse or similar observability/evaluation platforms.
* RAG/retrieval pipelines, vector databases, rerankers/cross\-encoders, Hugging Face/open\-source models.
* AWS (OpenSearch, S3, EC2, RDS), high\-volume search, NLP/information retrieval/recommendation systems.
* Familiarity with MRR, NDCG, Recall@K and Precision@K; Docker and CI/CD.


**What We're Looking For**
 Someone extremely hands\-on with data who thinks in SQL first, is deeply comfortable with MySQL and data modelling, and can move seamlessly between data engineering, analytics and AI experimentation. You should be comfortable going from data → experiment → evaluation → optimisation → production, while also building reporting layers for business users.
   

  

 WHY THIS ROLE IS INTERESTING
   

  

 Own the full data lifecycle: how data is stored, queried, used for analytics, powers search and powers AI. This is a rare opportunity where data engineering, analytics and AI engineering converge in one system, with direct influence over how data is structured, search works and AI systems behave in production.
   

  

 EDUCATION
   

  

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Engineering or a related field. Equivalent practical experience is also considered.
   

  

 Powered by Webbtree

title: Data Scientist, Fraud Risk Mitigation
description:
**Role Summary** 




 Data Scientist supporting fraud strategy development, fraud analytics, and operational monitoring across a consumer lending portfolio. Working under the fraud strategy lead and alongside senior team members, you will analyze fraud trends, monitor portfolio and decisioning performance, and help translate findings into policy and rule recommendations for the decision engine.
 



 This is an individual\-contributor role for someone with strong analytical fundamentals and hands\-on SQL and Python skills who wants to build depth in fraud risk. Day\-to\-day work is weighted toward analysis, recurring reporting, monitoring, and cross\-functional execution with fraud operations, product, credit/risk, and data engineering — including scorecard and model performance monitoring.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Analyze fraud trends and emerging patterns across application, behavioral, device, and third party data, and summarize findings with clear supporting evidence.
 



 • Monitor fraud performance metrics and operational outcomes — loss rates, capture rates, false positive rates, approval impact, vintage trends, and segment\-level KPIs — and flag issues for review.
 



 • Support policy, rule, and threshold recommendations for the decision engine, sizing expected impact and recommending changes with guidance from the fraud strategy lead and senior team members.
 



 • Prepare recurring fraud reports and deep dives — loss attribution, typology trends, and decisioning outcomes — with commentary on drivers of change.
 



 • Track fraud scorecard and model performance (PSI, score drift, KS, decay) and monitor reason code and segment\-level behavior, escalating signs of degradation.
 



 • Evaluate third\-party fraud and identity signals (identity verification, device intelligence, consortium data, bank/transaction data) and contribute benchmarking analysis to onboarding, retirement, and reweighting decisions.
 




 •
 
 Support test\-and\-learn analyses — champion/challenger tests, policy backtests, and holdouts — including data preparation, measurement, and result summaries.
 



 • Partner with fraud operations on case and queue feedback, translating investigator findings into analytical follow\-ups, rule ideas, and reporting improvements.
 



 • Work with product, data engineering, and decisioning platform teams to implement and monitor fraud rules and data signals, validating logic and post\-deployment results.
 



 • Run data quality checks on fraud reporting and analysis datasets, documenting assumptions, exclusions, and known limitations.
 



 • Document analyses, methodology, and recommendations so that findings are reproducible and easy for partners to review.
 




 •
 
 Contribute ideas and observations to the broader fraud strategy agenda and follow shared analytical, code review, and reporting standards.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • 1–3 years of experience in fraud analytics, risk analytics, data science, credit risk, fintech or financial services analytics, or a closely related quantitative field.
 



 • Strong hands\-on SQL and Python skills used for real analysis, segmentation, and reporting.
 



 • Experience working with large structured/tabular datasets, including cleaning, joining, and quality validation.
 



 • Experience building or maintaining dashboards and recurring reporting for business partners
 



 • Understanding of fraud typologies in consumer lending — identity, synthetic, first\-party, and third\-party fraud — or clear curiosity and willingness to learn them.
 



 • Working familiarity with how scores, rules, and thresholds drive decisions, with the ability to interpret outputs and monitor performance.
 



 • Ability to work effectively with guidance — taking direction on scope and method, asking good questions, and delivering carefully checked work.
 



 • Clear written and verbal communication; able to explain analyses, results, and caveats to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
 



 • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related), or equivalent practical experience.
 



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 




 • Consumer lending, fintech, or financial services experience, particularly subprime or near\-prime personal loans.
 



 • Experience partnering with fraud operations or investigations teams on case and queue outcomes.
 



 • Exposure to third\-party fraud and identity data providers and to benchmarking their signals.
 



 • Familiarity with decision engines or rules platforms and how fraud rules are configured, deployed, and monitored.
 



 • Experience with experimentation and measurement (champion/challenger, A/B tests, backtests, holdouts).
 



 • Exposure to scorecard or model performance monitoring (PSI, KS, calibration, reason\-code analysis).
 



 • Exposure to identity, synthetic, first\-party, or third\-party fraud patterns in application and account data.
 



 • Familiarity with US consumer lending regulations and risk management practices.

**About Nference**

Our platforms help pharmaceutical companies, healthcare providers, and research organizations unlock insights from complex clinical, molecular, and imaging data to drive better decisions and improve patient outcomes.

 **EHRs, patient notes, medical codes, laboratory data, and physiological data such as ECGs** 
 , while gaining exposure to machine learning and healthcare technology.

* Review patient notes and other EHR data to identify and interpret clinically relevant information.

* Support clinical validation of datasets, algorithms, and AI\-generated outputs by identifying clinically relevant errors or inconsistencies.

* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Clinical teams to clarify requirements and resolve domain\-specific questions.
* Support literature reviews and clinical or scientific research relevant to ongoing projects.
* Assist in defining appropriate clinical concepts, terminology, outcomes, and data elements for research and product use cases.
* Contribute to documentation of clinical definitions, data sources, annotation guidelines, research findings, and project requirements.
* Participate in quality assurance activities to ensure clinical data and outputs meet defined standards.
* Identify gaps or ambiguities in clinical data and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
* Stay updated on relevant clinical, scientific, and healthcare technology developments and assess their potential relevance to ongoing projects.


**Required Qualifications**
**What We're Looking For**
* MBBS degree is mandatory.
* Strong understanding of clinical medicine and patient care.
* Ability to understand and interpret clinical information from patient records and healthcare datasets.
* Basic understanding of ECG interpretation.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with clinical data and annotation tasks.
* Strong interest in clinical research, healthcare technology, AI, and product development.
* Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams including clinicians, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to understand complex clinical problems and communicate them clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently on defined tasks while seeking appropriate guidance when required.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Clinical or academic exposure to Cardiology, Internal Medicine, Critical Care, or ICU settings.
* Familiarity with EHR systems, clinical documentation, patient notes, or healthcare datasets.
* Experience with clinical data annotation, medical coding, data curation, or clinical research.
* Basic understanding of Python or R.
* Basic understanding of SQL.
* Basic understanding of biostatistics and clinical research methodology.
* Familiarity with medical terminology, disease classifications, procedure codes, laboratory terminology, or healthcare ontologies.
* Exposure to AI, machine learning, deep learning, or healthcare analytics projects.
* Experience working with multidisciplinary research, healthcare, or technology teams.
* Experience contributing to scientific publications, research projects, clinical studies, or healthcare product development.


**Why Join nference?**
 At nference, you'll work at the intersection of
 **medicine, artificial intelligence, software engineering, and biomedical research** 
 .
   

  

 You'll have the opportunity to apply your clinical knowledge to real\-world healthcare data and contribute to technologies that support biomedical research, drug discovery, and healthcare innovation.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Data Scientists, AI researchers, software engineers, physicians, clinical scientists, and product leaders, gaining practical exposure to how clinical expertise is translated into data\-driven healthcare solutions.
   

  

 As a Junior Clinical Scientist, you'll build experience across
 **clinical data, AI model development, research, clinical validation, and healthcare product development** 
 while developing your understanding of emerging technologies in healthcare.
   

  

**Benefits \& Perks**
* Industry Prestige: Build your career at an AI\-first healthcare technology company working at the intersection of AI, software engineering, and biomedical research.
* Cutting\-Edge Innovation: Gain exposure to AI and machine learning applications involving clinical, molecular, imaging, and unstructured healthcare data.
* Meaningful Impact: Contribute to technologies that accelerate biomedical research and improve healthcare outcomes.
* Growth \& Flexibility: Work in a collaborative, innovation\-driven environment with continuous learning opportunities and a hybrid work model for eligible employees after successful completion of the three\-month probation period.
* Wellness \& Perks: Enjoy reimbursements for gym memberships, technology gadgets, high\-speed internet, professional development, comprehensive health insurance, and complimentary breakfast, lunch, and snacks at our Bangalore office.

 We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in building technology that transforms healthcare.

AI Voice Agent Developer

 OneNDF

 New Delhi

 Full\-time Not a work from home

 OneNDF is a fintech platform focused on
 **Home Loans and Loan Against Property** 
 , combining lending intelligence, lender matchmaking and AI\-led customer engagement.
 



 We are building AI agents that can interact with customers, partners and bank/NBFC representatives through
 **voice and WhatsApp** 
 , understand natural conversations, collect information intelligently and take the conversation forward based on context.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an
 **AI Voice Agent Developer** 
 who is excited about building conversational AI systems that can talk to real customers.
 



 This is a hands\-on development role.
 



 You will work on AI voice agents that can:
 


* Conduct natural two\-way conversations
* Understand English, Hindi and Hinglish
* Ask intelligent follow\-up questions
* Handle interruptions and changing conversation paths
* Extract structured information from calls
* Use business data and APIs during conversations
* Trigger workflows after a call

 **AI agents that can understand the context of a conversation and respond naturally.** 



 What You Will Work OnReal\-Time AI Voice Agents
 * Build and improve real\-time conversational voice agents.
* Integrate Speech\-to\-Text, LLM and Text\-to\-Speech systems.
* Build low\-latency voice pipelines.
* Handle interruptions, silence, turn\-taking and natural conversation flow.
* Develop Hindi, English and Hinglish conversational capabilities.

 Conversational Intelligence
 * Design conversation flows and AI\-agent behaviour.
* Build prompt and context\-management systems.
* Enable agents to remember information collected earlier in a conversation.
* Make agents ask relevant follow\-up questions rather than blindly following scripts.
* Build objection\-handling and conversation\-branching logic.

 LLM \& Tool Integration

* LLM APIs such as OpenAI and Gemini
* CRM systems
* Customer databases
* Lending calculators
* Internal APIs
* WhatsApp workflows
* Knowledge bases
* Lead\-management systems



 Enable the AI agent to call tools during conversations—for example, checking an eligibility calculation or retrieving relevant information before responding.
 


 Call Intelligence
 
 Build systems to automatically capture:
 


* Call transcripts
* Customer requirements
* Key information collected
* Customer objections
* Follow\-up actions
* Conversation outcome
* Lead qualification
* Structured CRM fields



 Create mechanisms to convert an unstructured conversation into usable structured data.
 


 Freshers Can Apply

* AI agents
* Voice bots
* Chatbots
* LLM applications
* Python automation
* OpenAI / Gemini APIs
* Real\-time applications



 A working project is more valuable to us than only having certificates.
 



 If you have built something using AI,

 What Will Make You Stand Out

* Built an AI voice bot yourself

The agents you will build here carry that same standard into enterprise workflows.
 



  




 The role
 
 We are hiring a founding engineer with an AI \+ backend bent to build durable AI agents for financial and enterprise workflows.
 



  





 This role combines backend engineering, applied AI, and forward deployed engineering. You will build agent infrastructure, run evals, create reusable harnesses, and work directly with customers to turn real workflows into production systems.
 



  





 You will work across orchestration, state management, tool execution, APIs, background processing, observability, integrations, and deployment.

We care more about technical ability and what you have built than credentials or years of experience. Strong GitHub work, OSS contributions, production systems, research, and serious side projects all matter.

 Comfortable with APIs, databases, queues, concurrency, retries, caching, state, and observability.
* **Applied AI experience.** 
 Familiar with LLMs, agents, tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, memory, and orchestration.
* **Strong on evals.** 
 Comfortable building evaluation datasets, regression tests, traces, and failure analysis workflows.
* **Customer\-facing.** 
 Able to understand messy business processes, ask the right questions, and translate them into technical systems.
* **Systems\-oriented.** 
 You think about reliability, scale, failure modes, and architecture, not just feature implementation.

 Good GitHub, OSS contributions, technical projects, or evidence of shipping meaningful systems.

 You learn quickly, go deep when needed, and can make progress without detailed instructions.
* **AI\-native developer.** 
 Comfortable using tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, or similar systems as part of your development workflow.



  




 What you will do
 * Build backend services for Winsen Labs' agent platform
* Build durable, stateful, long\-running workflows
* Design reusable harnesses for financial and enterprise use cases
* Run evals and build regression testing infrastructure
* Build tool execution, integrations, and background processing
* Add tracing, replay, logging, and monitoring
* Work directly with customers from discovery to deployment
* Improve reliability, performance, and scalability
* Contribute to core technical and architectural decisions



  




 Hiring process
 1. **Application review.** 
 Resume, GitHub, OSS work, and projects reviewed using automated screening and human review.
2. **Intro call, online.** 
 Non\-technical conversation to understand your background, interests, and working style.
3. **Take\-home assignment.** 
 Practical engineering exercise.
4. **Technical interview, online.** 
 Discussion around the assignment, backend fundamentals, AI systems, and engineering decisions.



  




 Why Winsen Labs
 * You will join early, own meaningful systems, work closely with customers, and have direct influence on product and architecture.

description:
**Overview:** 




 We’re the global talent technology leader intelligently solving the most critical challenges for employers and delivering results that strengthen their organizations. Our unified platform, augmented by rich data and deep industry expertise, is revolutionizing how employers attract and hire the talent they need – through connected intelligence.
 



  





 The work we create for our clients is so much more than websites, strategy, or media. It’s leveraging the connected intelligence of our unified platform to deliver creative and technology solutions that are tailored specifically to their needs and designed to solve their greatest challenges.
 



  





  





**About the job:** 




 We are seeking a motivated
 **QA Engineer** 
 to join the Delivery QA team in our Bengaluru GDC.
 



 This is a hands\-on QA role focused on validating client implementations built on the Radancy platform throughout the delivery lifecycle. Each implementation may have different client requirements, configurations, content, functionality and design specifications requiring strong attention to detail, sound testing judgement and proactive communication.
 



  





**Reports to:** 
 QA Engineer Lead – Delivery QA
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Delivery \& Implementation Testing** 



* Perform QA validation throughout the delivery lifecycle including Preview, Soft Launch, Production Launch, defect retesting, maintenance and regression testing.
* Validate functionality against requirements, scope and approved specifications.
* Perform visual and design validation against approved designs.
* Perform responsive/mobile and cross\-browser testing.
* Perform accessibility testing using appropriate automated and manual techniques including tools such as Axe DevTools, WAVE and Lighthouse, as well as keyboard and screen\-reader testing where required.
* Perform CMS and content\-management validation, including configuration, content behaviour and editor functionality.
* Verify copy and content against approved source material.
* Perform multilingual verification where applicable.
* Identify, document and communicate defects, risks and testing concerns clearly.



**Defect Management \& Collaboration** 



* Document defects clearly in BugHerd including reproduction steps, evidence, severity and relevant context.
* Work closely with DPM, Development and Implementation/Configuration teams to clarify issues and support resolution.
* Communicate testing progress, blockers, risks and dependencies proactively.
* Raise missing requirements, access issues or scope concerns that may prevent effective testing.
* Manage assigned QA activities and priorities across multiple concurrent implementations.
* Take ownership of assigned work, plan testing activities proactively and ensure work is completed within agreed timelines.



**QA Improvement \& Automation** 



* Follow established Delivery QA processes, standards and readiness requirements.
* Contribute to improvements in QA processes, documentation, tools and ways of working.
* Identify repetitive and predictable testing activities that may be suitable for automation.
* Participate in evaluating QA automation initiatives and provide feedback on accuracy, usability and suitability for Delivery QA.
* Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the QA team.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**Required** 



* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in software quality assurance/testing.
* Strong experience with manual testing of web applications.
* Experience with functional, visual, responsive and cross\-browser testing.
* Sound testing judgement and ability to assess risks, priorities and testing scope across different implementations.
* Experience identifying, documenting and retesting defects.
* Experience using defect\-management tools such as BugHerd or equivalent.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify functional, visual and content\-related issues.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple concurrent assignments.
* Ability to proactively identify and communicate blockers, risks and dependencies.
* Comfortable working in a delivery environment where requirements and implementation scope may vary between projects.



**Preferred** 



* Experience testing client\-facing websites or digital experiences preferably in a delivery environment.
* Experience with accessibility testing and tools such as Axe DevTools, WAVE, Lighthouse or NVDA and working knowledge of WCAG.
* Experience with CMS or content\-management systems.
* Experience with mobile/responsive web testing.
* Experience with multilingual website testing.
* Experience using BrowserStack or similar cross\-browser/device testing platforms.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS and browser developer tools.
* Exposure to QA automation tools such as Playwright, Selenium or Cypress.



  





**Work Location** 




**Hybrid Work Model:** 
 This is a hybrid position, requiring you to work in the Bengaluru office 3 times per week.
 



  





**Company Values** 




 At Radancy, we are dedicated to the core values that guide our work and culture:
 



**Innovative Spirit** 
 — Innovation leads the way. We have a rich history of developing and delivering what's new and next while valuing every voice on our team. Together, we're shaping the future and leading the industry forward.
 



**Rewarding Impact** 
 — Work that matters. We strengthen organizations with transformative software that connects people around the world to meaningful careers. This work makes a difference in people's lives and inspires our team to advance technology with purpose.
 



**Performance Driven** 
 — Success drives results. We use data and insights to inform strategy and maximize performance for our customers, all backed by our global teams committed to exceeding expectations with unmatched expertise and support.
 



**Supportive Teams** 
 — Collaboration is our backbone. We foster an environment that inspires our team members to deliver industry\-defining technology. We empower our teams to learn from each other, grow their skills and create positive change in their work and communities.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Comply Ark is hiring a QA Engineer to own testing across both of our products. Engineers here unit\-test their own code. Everything above that is yours.
 



  





**About Comply Ark** 




  





 Comply Ark is a regulatory infrastructure company building software for compliance with India's data protection law, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA). We build two products: DataLens, an enterprise platform for finding personal data and managing compliance around it, and CookieGate, a cookie consent platform for websites in India and other countries. The company was founded by a data protection lawyer and a software architect, and is incubated at ISB DLabs and IIIT Hyderabad.
 



  





**The Product** 




  





 Most privacy tools need access to the very data they are meant to protect. DataLens does not. It is data\-blind: DataLens scans inside the customer's infrastructure, where it finds and classifies personal data across databases, file stores and employee devices, including documents in Indian languages, and only opaque identifiers and metadata ever reach our cloud. Plaintext personal data never leaves the customer's environment, which is why banks, hospitals and other regulated enterprises can adopt it. The discovery and detection engine is already built and approaching its first release. What you will test is that engine as it ships, and the layer being built on top of it that turns discovery into compliance, from consent and Data Principal rights to breach management, retention and audit, on an architecture where one careless log line can break the product's core promise.
 



  





**How We Build** 




  





 We work spec\-first, and AI coding tools, write most of our code. Every feature starts as a specification that sets out the legal requirement, the expected behaviour, the edge cases and the data the feature may and may not touch. Engineers build against it and unit\-test their own code. Generated code can compile, pass its own tests and still be wrong, and in a product whose value depends on personal data never crossing a boundary, independent testing is what catches it.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




  





 • Review specifications before build begins, flag gaps and ambiguities, and turn requirements into acceptance criteria and test plans.
 



 • Own all testing above unit level (integration, end\-to\-end, regression and performance), automated and running in CI.
 



 • Prove that the data\-blind boundary holds: no plaintext personal data reaches the cloud, including through logs, error messages, telemetry and debug output, and under failures, retries and version mismatches.
 



 • Measure detection quality for Indian identifiers such as Aadhaar and PAN, and for names and addresses in Indian languages and scripts, using labelled datasets, precision and recall tracking, and regression checks.
 



 • Test DataLens end to end across its desktop application, the scanning application inside customer environments and the cloud application, along with its connectors to databases and file stores.
 



 • Test compliance features as they arrive, such as consent, breach reporting, data deletion and people's rights over their data, against the specification and the law they implement.
 



 • Test CookieGate's website crawler, cookie classification, region\-aware consent SDK and tamper\-evident consent ledger.
 



 • Design tests for enterprise scale: synthetic data at volume, sampling, statistical checks and throughput measurement.
 



 • Test access control, tenant isolation, installation and upgrades, and re\-test security fixes.
 



 • Own release readiness, with reproducible defect reports and a clear go or no\-go.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





 • 2\+ years in QA, SDET or test engineering, including owning test automation for a product in real use. We weigh what you have caught, and how you caught it, above the number.
 



 • Basic coding in Python, Go or JavaScript/TypeScript, enough to write automation scripts that drive an application through its interface or APIs and check the results against the spec.
 



 • Ability to generate realistic test data for databases at volume, including edge cases and malformed values, and to query what the system did with it.
 



 • Strong test design: boundaries, equivalence classes, state transitions, negative testing and risk\-based prioritisation.
 



 • An understanding of how multi\-component systems fail: network faults, retries, partial failures and version skew.
 



 • Everyday use of AI assistants, with the habit of checking what they produce.
 



 • Clear written English. Your bug reports should reproduce on the first attempt.
 



  





**Good to Have** 




  





 • Experience evaluating ML or NLP systems.
 



 • Testing desktop applications and installers on Windows, macOS and Linux.
 



 • Browser\-level testing of cookies, third\-party scripts or consent tools.
 



 • Performance testing with tools such as k6, Locust or JMeter.
 



 • Security testing basics: the OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorisation, TLS.
 



 • Ability to read one or more Indian languages besides English.
 



 • Familiarity with the DPDPA or GDPR. Not required. You will learn the domain directly from a former data protection lawyer.
 



  





**Tech Environment** 




  





 Go, PostgreSQL, React and TypeScript, a Python NLP service using named\-entity recognition and locally hosted language models, mutual TLS between tiers, desktop installers for Windows, macOS and Linux, and AI coding tools, primarily Claude Code.
 



  





**Work Setup** 




  





 Full\-time, primarily work from home, with travel to our Kochi or Hyderabad office roughly once a month for team meetings, reviews and company events. You should be based within reasonable travel distance of either city.
 



  





**Why Join** 




  





 You will set the quality bar for two products at an early stage, work directly with both founders on the legal reasoning and the architecture, and help decide what testing means when most of the code is generated.
 



  





**This Role Is Probably Not For You If** 




  





 You measure your work by the number of test cases executed, you would rather run scripted manual checks than work out what could break, or you would sign off a release you cannot explain.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




  





 Apply here on LinkedIn, or email your CV, current location and notice period to careers@complyark.com in copy, using the subject line "QA Engineer \- \[Your Name]".
 



  




* Comply Ark is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds.

title: Associate - Quality Assurance(CAO Controls Management)
description:
**Job Description**
 The Global Supplier Services (GSS) Quality Assurance (QA) function, a sub\-function within CAO Controls Management, performs end\-to\-end assurance reviews across the GSS lifecycle to proactively identify and assess operational risks, validate that controls are designed and operating effectively, and confirm processes are robust and sustainable.
   

  

 In this role, you will execute end\-to\-end QA review activities (including testing strategy, execution, analysis, and management reporting) and support risk\-based planning/scoping to help mitigate the risk of errors and provide ongoing assurance to management.
   

  

* Participate in QA reviews end\-to\-end, including developing testing strategies, executing testing, and analyzing results.
* Support the delivery of targeted thematic reviews aligned to regulatory commitments, business priorities and emerging risk themes.
* Execute control and process testing across critical process steps, data elements, and key operational risk points within the GSS lifecycle.
* Obtain, organize, and evaluate supporting documentation to evidence what was tested and how conclusions were reached; maintain audit\-ready workpapers that stand alone for secondary review.
* Identify exceptions, perform preliminary root cause analysis, and draft clear, supportable documentation for review leads and stakeholder discussions.
* Support risk\-based planning and scoping through population review and analytics to identify anomalies and inform sample selection.
* Participate in walkthroughs with stakeholders and support audit\-ready documentation and control rationalization.
* Analyze program\-related data (e.g., KPI/KRI) and contribute to insightful reporting that supports risk and control priorities.
* Manage assigned deliverables across multiple workstreams, exercise sound judgment within established procedures, and escalate complex issues appropriately.
* May manage discrete projects/workstreams, including delegating tasks (as needed) and reviewing outputs for quality, completeness, and adherence to QA standards.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
 Successful candidates demonstrate strong analytical judgment, clear audit\-ready writing, and the ability to evaluate evidence and reach well\-supported conclusions while partnering effectively with stakeholders.
   

  

* 1\-2 years related experience in controls, audit, quality assurance, risk management, or compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to understand requirements quickly, evaluate evidence, and document conclusions clearly.
* Basic understanding of statistical and risk\-based sample methodologies and their application with quality assurance testing.
* Strong verbal and written communications, including the ability to produce clear, concise, well\-supported documentation.
* Strong organization skills; ability to multi\-task and prioritize deliverables across multiple workstreams.
* Ability to build effective working relationships and collaborate across teams and stakeholder groups.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Policies, Procedures, and Regulatory Requirements: Learns JPMC policies, standards, and regulations, applies requirements based on business and product context with guidance, adheres to current policies, and understands how regulations relate to risk and control environment.
* Data Literacy \& Automation Awareness: Reads and interprets basic data, learns analysis and automation techniques (including ML capabilities), identifies efficiency opportunities with guidance, communicates insights with support to ensure accuracy, and translates technical concepts to business value.

description:
**Company Description**
**The QIMA story**
 At QIMA, we’re on a mission to help our clients make products consumers can trust. Working with over 30,000 global brands, retailers, manufacturers and food growers, we are on the ground wherever products are made. We help businesses secure every step of their supply chain with quality inspections, supplier audits, certifications, and lab testing, all powered by our intelligent digital platform.
   

  

 Our team of 5,000 QIMers (and counting) across 40 offices and laboratories, are united in our shared passion for innovation and integrity, and guided by our QIMA values in the decisions we make every day. * Ability to read, write and communicate well in English.


**Additional Information**
 Does this describe you? Then we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Apply now and we can write the next chapter of the QIMA story together.

description:
Jubilant Pharma Limited is a global integrated pharmaceutical company offering a wide range of products and services to its customers across geographies. We organise our business into two segments, namely, Specialty Pharmaceuticals, comprising Radiopharmaceuticals (including Radio pharmacies), Contract Manufacturing of Sterile Injectable, Non\-sterile \& Allergy Therapy Products, and Generics \& APIs, comprising Solid Dosage Formulations \& Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients.
   

  

 Jubilant Generics (JGL) is a wholly \- owned subsidiary of Jubilant Pharma. JGL in India has Research \& Development units at Noida and Mysore. It has two manufacturing facilities one at Mysore, Karnataka and another at Roorkee, Uttarakhand, engaged in APIs and Dosage manufacturing, respectively.
   

  

 The manufacturing location at Mysore is spread over 69 acres and it’s a USFDA approved site engaged in manufacturing of APIs, and caters to the sales worldwide. API portfolio focusses on Lifestyle driven Therapeutic Areas (CVS, CNS) and targets complex and newly approved molecules. The company is the market leader in four APIs and is amongst the top three players for another three APIs in its portfolio helping it maintain a high contribution margin. The manufacturing location at Roorkee, Uttarakhand is state of the art facility and is audited and approved by USFDA, Japan PMDA, UK MHRA, TGA, WHO and Brazil ANVISA. This business focusses on B2B model for EU, Canada and emerging markets.

title: DevOps Engineer Intern
description:

This internship is an excellent opportunity for candidates who want to gain hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, automation, deployment, monitoring, and modern DevOps practices.

As a DevOps Intern, you will work closely with developers and technical teams to support application deployment, infrastructure management, and automation processes.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in setting up and maintaining **CI/CD pipelines**.
* Support application build, testing, and deployment processes.
* Work with developers to improve development and deployment workflows.
* Assist in managing cloud infrastructure and services.
* Help with server configuration, monitoring, and maintenance.
* Support containerization using **Docker**.
* Assist with basic **Kubernetes** configuration and deployment.
* Monitor application and infrastructure performance.
* Help identify and troubleshoot deployment and environment\-related issues.
* Assist in automating repetitive tasks and operational processes.
* Maintain technical documentation for infrastructure and deployment processes.

Required Skills

* Basic understanding of **DevOps concepts and practices**.
* Familiarity with **Linux/Unix commands and environments**.
* Basic knowledge of **Git and GitHub/GitLab**.
* Understanding of **CI/CD concepts**.
* Basic knowledge of **Docker and containerization**.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as **AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud**.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts.
* Knowledge of scripting using **Bash, Shell, or Python** is a plus.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.

Good to Have

* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code tools such as **Terraform or Ansible**.

Eligibility

What You Will Learn

* Real\-world CI/CD workflows.
* Application deployment and release processes.
* Cloud infrastructure fundamentals.
