title: Sr. Engineer – Pen Tester
description:
**About Us**
 Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 The Penetration Tester is a critical member of the Application Security team, focused on identifying, validating, and resolving security vulnerabilities across our cloud infrastructure and applications. You will lead technical security assessments, including application\-layer and network\-layer penetration testing, to ensure all information assets are secured against evolving threats. This role is vital for maintaining our security posture and ensuring remediation efforts are effectively prioritized and executed.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Perform comprehensive manual and automated application\-layer penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities, adhering to industry standards and internal methodologies.
* Conduct network\-layer penetration tests encompassing all components supporting network functions and operating systems.
* Validate segmentation and scope\-reduction controls at least annually and after any significant changes to ensure isolation of the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE).
* Triage and validate vulnerabilities reported through bug bounty program.
* Document and risk\-rate all findings, providing actionable remediation guidance to engineering and product teams.
* Verify the correction of exploitable vulnerabilities through re\-testing and post\-remediation assessments.
* Collaborate with external 3rd party security firms on penetration testing and threat hunting exercises.
* Ensure all security assessments and remediation activities meet compliance and regulatory obligations (e.g., PCI DSS, SOC).


**Qualifications**
* Minimum of 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or application security engineering.
* Deep understanding of common web\-based attacks (SQLi, XSS, CSRF, XXE, etc.) and how to mitigate them at the application level.
* Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Go, Ruby, or Bash to automate security tasks.
* Comprehensive knowledge of network protocols and security concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, TLS, and IPSEC.
* Strong experience with security testing tools (e.g., BurpSuite Enterprise, SAST, DAST, and IAST).
* Working knowledge of OWASP security fundamentals and API identity/access management (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT).
* Ability to work with high autonomy and communicate technical security findings clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Relevant information security certification(s) such as OSCP, CEH, OSWE, or CISSP.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Direct experience managing or triaging a public bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, BugCrowd).
* Experience leveraging Slack/ChatOps to automate security tasks or reporting.
* Experience with cloud orchestration and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Google Deployment Manager).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tooling like Docker and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC2, or CCPA.

title: GCP Infra Security (GCP + AI+ DevSecOps) - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
 Deloitte Cyber understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful insights to help our clients navigate the ever\-changing threat landscape. Through powerful insights and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure achievements.
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Solution Advisor
   

  

**Work you’ll do:**
 As a Consultant, you will be supporting the clients with their Cyber needs specifically helping them protect and secure their Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure . This will include:
   

  

* Assist in designing and implementing secure Google Cloud Platform infrastructure solutions under the guidance of senior consultants and managers.
* Support security assessments, threat modeling, and risk analysis activities for client GCP environments.
* Help review and update Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, service account configurations, VPC architectures, and firewall rules.
* Contribute to integrating security tools and controls into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows.
* Support the configuration and tuning of cloud\-native security services, such as VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, IAM, and Security Command Center.
* Help develop and maintain secure Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) templates using tools like Terraform or Deployment Manager.
* Assist in implementing security controls and processes to help client environments meet relevant security standards and frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS).
* Collaborate with client stakeholders and internal teams to align security activities with business objectives.
* Help prepare documentation and training materials to support client teams in managing their GCP security posture.
* Support GCP Security, Compliance \& Controls initiatives, including governance, identity, network security, and data protection.
* Understanding of Wiz for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP), container and Kubernetes security, vulnerability management, and risk prioritization.
* Assist in securing AI and GenAI workloads on GCP, including Vertex AI and Gemini\-based environments, by supporting the implementation of controls across access management, data protection, prompt security, and logging and monitoring.
* Contribute to the secure operation of AI/ML services by leveraging GCP native and AI assisted security capabilities, including Security Command Center insights, threat detection, and risk prioritization.


**The Team:**
 Enterprise Security teams embed security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client’s “technical backbone” while also enabling secure digital transformation. Services include security architecture, secure development and deployment, end\-to\-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products. Examples of work include Secure by Design, Cloud Security Orchestration \& Automation, Core Infrastructure Security, and Secure Software Enablement.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* 4\+ years of experience in cloud security or cloud infrastructure, with hands\-on exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its security features.
* Familiarity with designing and implementing secure GCP architectures, preferably as part of a team.
* Understanding of cloud security principles, such as least\-privilege access and zero\-trust concepts.
* Experience with GCP networking, IAM, data protection and related security controls.
* Exposure to infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager).
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and integrating security controls.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Bash) for automation tasks.
* Knowledge of container security (e.g., GKE, Kubernetes RBAC, image scanning) is a plus.
* Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to contribute to client discussions and documentation.
* Understanding of AI/GenAI security on GCP, including Vertex AI and Gemini\-based environments, with knowledge of access control, data protection, prompt security, and logging and monitoring practices.
* Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, and compliance requirements, along with GCP\-native security capabilities to support model risk management, threat detection, and risk prioritization across AI/ML solutions.


**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**
* Relevant security certifications (e.g., GCP Associate Cloud Engineer, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CompTIA Security\+) are a plus.
* Awareness of Vertex AI, Generative AI, and AI security concepts, including governance, data privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS, or MITRE ATT\&CK, and applying them to GCP environments.


**Education:**
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, or equivalent experience.


**Location:**
* Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata

title: Analyst, Identity Access Management Administrator
description:
SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve.
   

  

 At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team!
   

  

**Job Functions Supporting SailPoint**
* User Access Management
+ Create, modify, and disable user accounts across enterprise systems and applications.
+ Process access requests in accordance with established policies and approval workflows.
+ Perform user onboarding, transfers, and offboarding activities.
+ Maintain role\-based access controls (RBAC) and user group memberships.
+ Help provision and deprovision access across enterprise systems and cloud platforms.

* Identity Administration
+ Support the administration of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), LDAP, or similar identity platforms.
+ Manage password resets, account unlocks, and Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) enrollment.
+ Assist with Single Sign\-On (SSO) configuration and troubleshooting.
+ Document IAM configurations, procedures, and operational processes.

* AWS Identity \& Access Management
+ Assist in creating and managing AWS IAM users, groups, roles, and policies.
+ Support the implementation and maintenance of least\-privilege access controls.
+ Help manage IAM roles for AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, RDS, and other cloud resources.
+ Troubleshoot basic AWS access issues, including permission errors, policy conflicts, and role assumption problems.
+ Support access provisioning and deprovisioning within AWS environments.
+ Maintain documentation of AWS IAM configurations, standards, and procedures.

* Access Governance \& Compliance
+ Conduct periodic user access reviews and certification campaigns.
+ Ensure compliance with security policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
+ Maintain accurate documentation of access control procedures and user permissions.
+ Support internal and external audits by providing access\-related evidence and reports.
+ Assist in monitoring privileged access and segregation of duties controls.

* Incident \& Problem Management
+ Investigate and resolve identity and access\-related incidents.
+ Escalate complex issues to senior IAM administrators or security teams.
+ Monitor IAM systems and identify potential security concerns.
+ Participate in root\-cause analysis for recurring access issues.

* Reporting \& Documentation
+ Generate reports on user access, privileged accounts, and compliance metrics.
+ Maintain IAM operational procedures, knowledge base articles, and process documentation.
+ Track and document service requests through ticketing systems.

* Other activities as may be assigned by your manager


**Qualifications/ Requirements**
* Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Entry level professional with 0\-2 years of industry and/or relevant experience, typically at an Analyst level role or external equivalent.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Customer\-service mindset and ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders.
* Timely completion of user provisioning and deprovisioning requests.
* Compliance with access review schedules.
* Accuracy of user access assignments.
* Resolution time for IAM\-related incidents and requests.
* Audit findings related to identity and access controls.


**Note: This job description is not intended to be all inclusive or exclusive. At any time, employees may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization and participate in additional trainings. SitusAMC does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms or any third parties. Any unsolicited resume submitted to SitusAMC in any manner will be considered SitusAMC property, and SitusAMC will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.**
**The annual full time base salary range for this role is**
 ₹1\.00 \- ₹1\.00
   

  

 Specific compensation is determined through interviews and a review of relevant education, experience, training, skills, geographic location and alignment with market data. Additionally, certain positions may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus as determined by bonus program guidelines, position eligibility and SitusAMC Senior Management approval.
   

  

 SitusAMC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits plan.
   

  

 SitusAMC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India\-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125\-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship\-driven culture and our long\-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Value Proposition**
 As part of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at First Citizens Bank, the Senior Information Security Engineer (SailPoint Developer) will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, and support of SailPoint Identity Governance solutions. This role will focus on application onboarding, workflow development, lifecycle automation, provisioning integrations, and identity governance capabilities across the enterprise.
   

  

 The successful candidate will possess strong analytical and technical problem\-solving skills, experience in software development and IAM engineering, and a solid understanding of identity lifecycle management and access governance processes. This individual will support multiple IAM initiatives while contributing to platform enhancements, automation, and continuous improvement efforts.
   

  

**Job Details**
**Position:** 
 Information Security Engineer II \- IAM
   

  

**Career Level:** 
 P2
   

  

**Job Category:** 
 Senior Associate
   

  

**Role Type:** 
 Hybrid
   

  

**Job Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Identity and Access Management (IAM) Program supports end\-to\-end identity governance and access management for employees, contractors, and enterprise applications. The team is responsible for delivering secure, automated, and compliant identity lifecycle and access governance capabilities across the organization.
   

  

**Impact**
 This position resides within the Cyber Security organization and supports the engineering, development, enhancement, and maintenance of SailPoint Identity Security solutions. The role will contribute to application onboarding, workflow implementation, lifecycle automation, provisioning integrations, and access governance initiatives.
   

  

 This individual contributor role reports directly to the IAM Program Manager and collaborates closely with application teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, and business stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Deliverables (Duties And Responsibilities)**
* Design, develop, configure, and support SailPoint IdentityIQ and/or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud solutions.
* Implement and maintain identity lifecycle processes including Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) workflows.
* Develop and customize SailPoint workflows, rules, forms, policies, and provisioning processes.
* Onboard enterprise applications into SailPoint through connector\-based and custom integrations.
* Configure aggregation, correlation, identity mapping, entitlement harvesting, and provisioning capabilities.
* Develop custom integrations using REST APIs, Web Services, JDBC, LDAP, and other supported connectors.
* Create and maintain access request, approval, certification, and recertification workflows.
* Configure and maintain Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute\-Based Access Control (ABAC) models.
* Support Segregation of Duties (SoD) policy implementation and compliance requirements.
* Troubleshoot and resolve provisioning, aggregation, certification, and identity governance issues.
* Develop scripts and automation solutions to improve platform efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Partner with application owners and technology teams to gather requirements and onboard applications.
* Support platform upgrades, testing, deployment activities, and production releases.
* Participate in code reviews and follow secure development practices.
* Maintain technical documentation including design documents, runbooks, SOPs, and configuration standards.
* Ensure adherence to security policies, regulatory requirements, and audit obligations.


**Functional Skills**
**Skills and Qualifications (Functional and Technical Skills)**
* Strong experience in SailPoint application onboarding and identity governance implementations.
* Ability to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into technical IAM solutions.
* Experience implementing identity lifecycle management and access governance processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Self\-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.


**Technical / Business Skills**
* 4\+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management or Identity Governance Administration (IGA).
* 3\+ years of hands\-on SailPoint IdentityIQ
* Strong understanding of IAM concepts including:
+ Identity Lifecycle Management (JML)
+ Access Request and Approval Workflows
+ Provisioning and Deprovisioning
+ Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC)
+ Attribute\-Based Access Control (ABAC)
+ Segregation of Duties (SoD)
+ Access Certifications
+ Birthright and Business Roles


**SailPoint Technical Expertise**
* Identity Mapping
* Lifecycle Event Configuration
* Role and Entitlement Management
* Access Certifications
* Provisioning Policies
* Task Scheduling and Configuration
* Workflow Development and Customization
* Rule Development
* BeanShell Scripting
* Connector Configuration
* Custom Forms Development
* Custom Reports and Dashboards


**Development And Integration Skills**
* Java development experience.
* Experience with REST APIs, Web Services, and JSON/XML integrations.
* Knowledge of SQL and database concepts.
* Experience with PowerShell, BeanShell, Java, or Python scripting.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Understanding of LDAP, Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
* Knowledge of SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and Single Sign\-On (SSO) concepts is preferred.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer Certification
* Experience working in banking, financial services, or highly regulated environments.
* Experience integrating cloud and SaaS applications with SailPoint.
* Exposure to ServiceNow, CyberArk, Entra ID, or other IAM technologies.
* Understanding of audit, compliance, and access governance requirements.


**Accessibility Needs**
 We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodation at any stage (application, interviews, or onboarding), we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer to provide enterprise\-level assistance to our customers. You will diagnose and troubleshoot software and hardware problems and help our customers install applications and programs.
   

  

 Technical Support Engineer responsibilities include resolving network issues, configuring operating systems and using remote desktop connections to provide immediate support. You will use email and chat applications to give clients quick answers to simple IT issues. For more complex problems that require nuanced instruction, you will contact clients via phone and/or provide clear, written instructions and technical manuals.
   

  

 To be qualified for this role, you should hold a degree in a relevant field, like Computer Science, IT or Software Engineering. Microsoft, Cisco, Linux or similar certification is a plus. If youre naturally a helper, enjoy assisting people with computer issues and are able to explain technical details simply, wed like to meet you.
   

  

 Ultimately, you will be a person our customers trust. They will rely on you to provide timely and accurate solutions to their technical problems.
